# Nine to Fight: feature inventory

Project: `D:\Serban\software-projects\nine-to-fight`, branch `nine-to-fight-overhaul`. This describes the working tree on disk on 2026-10-25/26, including the 59 uncommitted or untracked paths (the grip pipeline `HeldItemGrips.json` / `HeldItemFitting.cs` / `ItemHoldPose.cs`, the new tests, and the regenerated clips, looks, prefabs and scene). It was built from the files, not from git history.

**After the audit, the owner approved a round of fixes and rebuilds.** They are listed in changelog (d), with before, after and reason for each.
- Section 1 (class index) is regenerated from the current tree.
- Sections 2–15 are the audit as taken. Their citations were moved automatically to the matching line in the current files.
- Where the cited code was removed or rewritten, the citation is marked ⟨pre-change⟩ and the row describes the audited state.
- Findings that the changelog fixed are annotated *[changed: changelog #n]*.

## How to read this document

- **Status** on every row is one of the following:
  - **WORKING**: wired and reachable in play.
  - **PARTIAL**: reachable, but incomplete or only some branches run.
  - **DEAD/UNUSED**: nothing reaches it; the row says what was searched.
  - **UNVERIFIED**: could not be settled from the files.
- WORKING is judged by tracing code paths and serialized references. Where a play test proves a row, the row cites the test.
- **Citations** take the form `path:line`, relative to the project root. Values are copied verbatim next to the citation.
- **Corrections to the brief:**
  - There are **17** prop prefabs, not 19. Catalog, prefab folder, grip JSON and icons all agree (§5/8 §1).
  - Grips are stored **per skeleton** (man / woman), not per look (§5/8 §3).
- **Section layout:**
  - Sections 5 and 8 (held items and props) form one section.
  - Section 9 is split: player classes are in §7.3, enemies in "Section 9 (enemy half)".
  - Sections 2, 13 and 15 come from one auditor and appear in numeric order.
  - Each area ends with a *Findings* block: bugs, risks and rebuild candidates, each cited.

## How it was produced and verified

- **Fan-out.** Ten auditors ran on Claude Sonnet, one per area. Each read every file in its scope, wrote its section and cited every claim. The orchestrator then merged their sections (Opus; it read and wrote but did not delegate).
- **Machine check of every citation.** A script resolved all **9,254** citations in the merged sections.
  - **0** point at a missing file or an out-of-range line.
  - For the 13,987 backticked values quoted next to citations, **10,465 (74.8%)** were found within ±3 lines of the cited line.
- **Manual check of what didn't match.** The orchestrator hand-checked a random sample of 25 unmatched numeric values. All 25 values were correct; 2 had line numbers that were off by more than a few lines.
  - **Known limitation:** in YAML assets (`.prefab`, `.unity`, `.asset`), some citations point at the start of the component block rather than the field's own line. One example: `minDepth: -2.5` is cited at `Player.prefab:10228` but sits at line 10249. The value is right; search the block for the field.
  - Most of the rest of the unmatched tokens are labels such as method names, cross-references and screenshot paths.
- **Manual check of headline findings.** The orchestrator re-read about 30 of the headline findings against the source. All of them were confirmed. They are:
  - the clip path bypassing the procedural pose path, `CharacterVisual.cs:519-523`;
  - `Pause()` not disabling control;
  - the stun overwrite, `EnemyBrain.cs:501`;
  - AoE knockback along facing, `AttackExecutor.cs:132`;
  - no input buffer, `AttackExecutor.cs:55`;
  - hit-stop honouring only the first request, `GameFlow.cs:726`;
  - the IT Support `dodgeCooldown: 0.3`;
  - `Health.AnyDied` having no subscriber;
  - the banner overwrite, `GameFlow.cs:122-125`;
  - gamepad Start bound to both Submit and Pause;
  - the Tutorial Dodge step requiring a hit;
  - `backhand.fbx` having no GUID reference;
  - `baseGround` never being read;
  - `Velocity` omitting the dash;
  - the `ItemHoldPose` null-check test being unable to fail;
  - the enemy-only projectile;
  - sticky music ducking;
  - `Sfx.Heartbeat` being unused;
  - the unwired tie, hair, eyes and brows on `Player.prefab`;
  - the `GetInstanceID` look seed;
  - the CC-BY credit for Woman_Suit;
  - the tautological `ImpactTime` test;
  - the unseeded Stock Options assertion;
  - `MotionReelTests` deleting its folder.
- **Baseline tests**, run through the Unity bridge before any change, on 2026-10-25:
  - **EditMode: 109/109 passed**, 31.7 s.
  - **PlayMode: 26/26 passed**, 464 s.
  - The per-test list and durations are in §14. The EditMode run has 93 test methods expanding to 109 cases.

## Sections 2, 13, 15 preamble


Audit scope: `D:\Serban\software-projects\nine-to-fight`, branch `nine-to-fight-overhaul`, working tree on disk (read-only). Unity editor version is `m_EditorVersion: 6000.3.10f1` (`ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt:1`).

Status meaning used here (static audit, nothing was executed): WORKING = file/asset present, every GUID/fileID resolves, builder code agrees with the on-disk values; PARTIAL = present but part of it is inert, stale or only half wired; DEAD/UNUSED = grep of `Assets/_Project` (and the other places named in the row) found no consumer; UNVERIFIED = could not be resolved statically.

Method note: a GUID to class table was built from every `*.cs.meta` under `Assets` (73 scripts). Both `.unity` and `.prefab` YAML were parsed object by object (every `m_Script` GUID resolved, every local `fileID` checked for existence, every external GUID looked up in `Assets/**/*.meta`). Results: 0 unknown MonoBehaviour scripts except the URP `Volume` (package script, resolved in `Library/PackageCache`), 0 dangling local references, 0 external GUIDs missing.

## 3a. Animation clips and import

Scope: the 30 Mixamo FBX clips, `manifest.json`, the 3 generated `.anim` clips, `FightAnimations.asset`, `UpperBody.mask`, `MIXAMO_ANIMATIONS.md`, the two Editor scripts and the runtime consumers (`FightAnimator.cs`, `CharacterVisual.cs`, `FightAnimationSet.cs`, `AttackPoses.cs`, `ClassMoveBook.cs`, `MoveLibrary.cs`, `FightingMove.cs`). All status values are from static reading of the on-disk files (nothing was played). "WORKING" means wired and reachable by code path, not play-tested. Clip lengths are derived as (lastFrame - firstFrame) / 30 and are corroborated by the last lift-curve key time of each strike in `FightAnimations.asset` (e.g. jab: 40 frames, last key `time: 1.3333334`). *[changed: changelog #13]*

Counts: 30 FBX clips (30 `.fbx.meta` all read via a full read of `jab.fbx.meta` plus a line-by-line diff of the other 29: every line in 1-530 and 862-885 is identical except guid, clip name, `lastFrame`, `loopTime` for fight_idle/block_idle and `firstFrame`/`lastFrame` for knockout; lines 531-861 differ only in rest-pose numbers, bone names/parents identical). 3 generated `.anim`. 1 `FightAnimations.asset` with 27 strike entries, 8 grounding entries, 2 hit clips. 1 `UpperBody.mask`. Rows below: 35 shared-import rows, 30 clip rows, 27 strike rows, 27 FightAnimationSet field rows, 6 generated-clip rows (3 clips plus settings, curve set and regeneration), 13 mask rows, 25 playback-graph rows, 26 editor-script rows (10 MixamoImport, 16 StarterContentBuilder.Animations), 16 procedural-only rows, 22 doc-diff rows.

### Strike entries in FightAnimations.asset (27 rows, one per AttackStyle)

Asset structure: `strikes:` starts at `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:24` `strikes:`. Each entry has style, clip, start, impact, end, ground, lift (curve, 30 fps keys every 1/30 s from `lift.AddKey(f * SampleStep, ...)` at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:125`), liftKept, landingYaw. "Rates" = DERIVED by me from the formulas at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:179` ⟨pre-change⟩ and `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:181` ⟨pre-change⟩ applied to every move (and every combo hit) that uses the style, using startup/active/recovery from `ClassMoveBook.cs`, `MoveLibrary.cs`, the PlayerClass/WorkerClass assets and `EnemyBrain.cs`; windup rate = (impact - clipStart) / preImpact where preImpact = startup + active x 0.5, recovery rate = (clipEnd - impact) / postImpact. Rate limits in code: wind-up between 0.75x and 2.4x, recovery between 0.8x and 2.2x (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:27` ⟨pre-change⟩). A rate sitting exactly on 2.40 or 2.20 means the clip had to be cut short or sped to the limit. Every strike plays on L2 (full body, no mask).

Style enum values come from `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/FightingMove.cs:12` onward (Jab=0 ... SupermanPunch=26). *[changed: changelog #22]*

### Generated clips (Idle.anim, Walk.anim, Run.anim)

Generator: `ConvertClip` in `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:316` called from `BuildFightAnimations` at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:72` (`ConvertClip(skeleton, avatar, "Idle")`, `"Walk"`, `"Run"`). Source is the Quaternius glb animation named `"CharacterArmature|" + name` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:319`) read from Man_Suit (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:65`). The same glb files carry 24 animations (Death, Gun_Shoot, HitRecieve, HitRecieve_2, Idle, Idle_Gun, Idle_Gun_Pointing, Idle_Gun_Shoot, Idle_Neutral, Idle_Sword, Interact, Kick_Left, Kick_Right, Punch_Left, Punch_Right, Roll, Run, Run_Back, Run_Left, Run_Right, Run_Shoot, Sword_Slash, Walk, Wave); only Idle, Walk, Run are converted (read directly from the JSON chunk of Man_Suit.glb). The conversion keeps only translation and rotation channels (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:333` `if (path != "translation" && path != "rotation") continue;`), poses the skeleton at 30 fps (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:356` `int frames = Mathf.Max(2, Mathf.RoundToInt(length * 30f) + 1);`) and reads back humanoid muscle values, dropping finger muscles (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:344`). Importer on the .anim files: `NativeFormatImporter` (`Assets/_Project/Art/Animations/Generated/Idle.anim.meta:5` `mainObjectFileID: 7400000`).

### UpperBody.mask

`Assets/_Project/Data/UpperBody.mask:10` `m_Mask: 00000000000000000100000000000000000000000100000001000000010000000100000000000000000000000000000000000000` is 13 little-endian ints in AvatarMaskBodyPart order (Root, Body, Head, LeftLeg, RightLeg, LeftArm, RightArm, LeftFingers, RightFingers, LeftFootIK, RightFootIK, LeftHandIK, RightHandIK). `m_Elements: []` (`Assets/_Project/Data/UpperBody.mask:11`), so there are no transform-path entries: it is a pure humanoid mask. Generated by `UpperBodyMask()` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:203`). Consumer: only L1 of the layer mixer (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:114`); L0 and L2 are unmasked.

### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

Dead / unused / partial:
- backhand.fbx and whip_crack.fbx are imported but never referenced (guid grep over Assets, ProjectSettings, Packages found only their own metas and manifest). AttackStyle.Backhand plays horizontal_swing (same as Sweep) and Whip plays diagonal_slash (same as DiagonalSlash): `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:31` and `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:36`. *[changed: changelog #21]*
- AttackStyle.Kick (front_kick.fbx) and AttackStyle.SupermanPunch (cross.fbx stand-in) have strike entries (`Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:3034`, `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:5011` ⟨pre-change⟩) but no move, class asset, worker asset or EnemyBrain override uses them, so they cannot occur in play. Only `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/AttackReelTests.cs:53` plays them. *[changed: changelog #22]*
- `FightAnimator.baseGround` is filled and never read (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:30` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:85` ⟨pre-change⟩), so 5 of the 8 `grounding` entries (`Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:17796`) have no runtime effect. *[changed: changelog #15]*
- `MixamoImport.Spins()` is dead code (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/MixamoImport.cs:24` ⟨pre-change⟩). *[changed: changelog #20]*
- Four toolkit pieces only work in the procedural fallback and are unreachable while `animationSet` is assigned: `FightStance` fidgets (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightStance.cs:34` ⟨pre-change⟩), `PoseKnockedOut`, the spring kicks on chest/head/arms, and the 27 hand-authored `AttackPoses` choreographies (only `ImpactTime` is still used live). *[changed: changelog #13]*
- Tie/hair/eyes/brows slots on CharacterVisual are empty on both prefabs (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8037`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:5763`).
- Quaternius glb animations Roll, Death, HitRecieve(_2), Wave, Interact, Run_Back/Left/Right are available but unconverted; 21 of 24 per-glb animations unused.

Suspected bugs and visible oddities:
- Dodge has no animation and the locomotion blend probably reads speed 0 during the 13 m/s dash: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:62` ⟨pre-change⟩ (`Velocity` omits `dashVelocity`) and `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:112` (`planarVelocity = Vector3.zero;`), `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:373`. Likely visible as skating in the standing pose (needs play check). *[changed: changelog #11]*
- Run.anim loop seam: first and last key differ on "Left Foot Up-Down" (`Assets/_Project/Art/Animations/Generated/Run.anim:7847` `value: 0.74934065` vs `Assets/_Project/Art/Animations/Generated/Run.anim:8063` `value: 0.5623101`), up to 0.187 muscle units; Idle and Walk close exactly. Possible foot pop every 0.79 s in the run cycle (UNVERIFIED visually). *[changed: changelog #42]*
- Loop Pose is off on the two Mixamo loops (`loopBlend: 0`, e.g. `Assets/_Project/Art/Animations/Mixamo/fight_idle.fbx.meta:46`); a bounce-seam pop in fight_idle/block_idle is possible (UNVERIFIED).
- Toss is documented as an underhand fling (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/FightingMove.cs:17`) and Reply All is described as "underhand, sidearm, overhand" (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/MoveLibrary.cs:46`), but both Toss and Hurl play the same overhand_throw clip; underhand_toss.fbx was never found (`Assets/_Project/Art/Animations/Mixamo/manifest.json:139`).
- Shared clips make moves look alike: Sweep = Backhand (3 Backhand class moves look identical to Sweep moves), DiagonalSlash = Whip, Hurl = Toss, Jab = SupermanPunch. *[changed: changelog #22]*
- Strike timing is clamped hard for many moves (DERIVED from the formulas, not read from one line): the wind-up reaches the 2.40x ceiling for Shove, Chop and Sweep/Backhand moves and 2.2-2.3x for Jab (cross); the recovery sits at the 2.20x ceiling for at least one move of 14 styles (LeadJab, Hook, Uppercut, Elbow, Knee, FlyingKick, Dropkick, Chop, Backhand, DiagonalSlash, Whip, Shove, Pound, Jab); see the Rates notes in the strike table and the clamps (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:27` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:179` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:181` ⟨pre-change⟩), so the clip's own follow-through is cut short on fast moves, while Cleave, Windmill, Blast, Lunge, Hurl/Toss, Whip and DiagonalSlash wind-ups sit at the 0.75x slow-motion floor (the move gives more time than the clip wants, so the clip is stretched).
- Lift curves look large for non-jump clips: front_kick `value: 1.1413438` (`Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:3414`), versus flying_kick 1.38 and dropkick 1.41 m; with liftKept 0.2 the code lowers the body by 80 percent of it (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:308`). Shove `ground: -0.057821073` (`Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:13045`) is an outlier versus every other entry near -0.15 to -0.17. Both UNVERIFIED.
- Generated locomotion grounding is about +1.0 (`Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:17797`, `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:17799`, `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:17801`) versus about -0.16 for Mixamo clips; harmless only because runtime re-measures the feet each frame (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:339`).
- Every hit reaction plays to the end of its clip (1.2-1.23 s) at 1:1 speed (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:314`) and only two reaction clips exist; a stunlocked feel is possible (UNVERIFIED).
- Knockout is permanent: `knockedOut` has no reset (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:331`) and `Cancel()` ignores Knockout (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:239`). Fine for enemies that are destroyed; open question for any player revive/restart flow that reuses the same visual.
- The manifest marks every Mixamo clip as not in-place; the pipeline discards XZ root motion (applyRootMotion false), so forward-stepping moves (Shove, Lunge, Dropkick, SuperPunch stand-in) rely on the move's `lunge` impulse, not the clip, for travel.
- Guard layer and base layer each own a separate fight_idle playable with independent random phases (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:96` and `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:111`), so the arms/head can be out of phase with the legs while fighting-walking (cosmetic, UNVERIFIED).

Open questions:
- Are the 30 FBX-generated avatars (avatarSetup 1) used by anything? No reference was found; setting avatarSetup to copy-from-other would drop 30 unused avatar sub-assets.
- Should superman_punch.fbx and underhand_toss.fbx be re-sourced, or should the Kick, SupermanPunch styles be given moves? MD row 15 marks superman_punch as required. *[changed: changelog #22]*
- Is the FindStrike impact frame correct for multi-phase clips (windmill impact at clip time 2.58 s, golf 1.15 s, shove 2.02 s)? Needs a visual check against the reel (`AttackReelTests`).

## 3b. Runtime animation pipeline (FightAnimator, FightAnimationSet, FightStance, AttackPoses, ItemHoldPose, RigFollower, Springs, plus the CharacterVisual call-in surface)

Method: every file in scope was read in full (FightAnimator 374 lines, FightAnimationSet 101, FightStance 229, AttackPoses 530, ItemHoldPose 34, RigFollower 223, Springs 87, CharacterVisual 958), plus the call sites in AttackExecutor, PlayerController, EnemyBrain, Health, HeldItemDisplay, CharacterMotor2_5D, Player.prefab, Coworker.prefab, FightAnimations.asset, PropCatalog.asset and UpperBody.mask. Unity was not run: "WORKING" means wired and reachable by static reading of code + serialized data, not observed on screen. Cell values are copied verbatim from the cited line. *[changed: changelog #13]*

**Headline finding.** `CharacterVisual` contains TWO complete animation pipelines. The shipped configuration runs the clip pipeline (`FightAnimator` PlayableGraph + `RigFollower` finger/grip/carry pass + one spring, the `joltSpring`). The older procedural pipeline (`AttackPoses` key poses, `FightStance` bounce/fidgets, 14 invisible pivot transforms driven by 11 springs (8 `SpringRotation` + 3 `Spring1`), `PoseKnockedOut`, `Dangle` tie/hair, `RigFollower`'s pivot-to-bone mapping) is only reachable when `animationSet == null` or no active Animator. Both prefabs assign the set (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8057` `animationSet: {fileID: 11400000, guid: cd9b8e445c91d1a4db9487d3e2f46600, type: 2}`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:5783` same value) and the only two prefabs that contain a CharacterVisual are Player and Coworker (grep of guid `4825938dcaa767349b81dbb8bea1379d` across prefab/unity/asset found only those two). The gate is `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:118` `if (animationSet == null || follower == null) return false;` and the clip branch returns early at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:520` ⟨pre-change⟩ `if (EnsureClips())`. *[changed: changelog #13]*

### 1. Per-class inventory

#### 1.1 FightAnimator (plain C# class, `IDisposable`, one instance per CharacterVisual per active body)

Purpose: builds a manual-update PlayableGraph on the humanoid Animator of the active body and plays Mixamo/Quaternius clips on 3 layers (base locomotion, upper-body guard, actions). `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:17` `public sealed class FightAnimator : IDisposable`.

Dependencies: `Animator` with humanoid Avatar and NO controller (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:4111` `m_Controller: {fileID: 0}`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:4114` `m_ApplyRootMotion: 0`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:4112` `m_CullingMode: 0`); `FightAnimationSet` ScriptableObject; `AttackPoses.ImpactTime` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:175` ⟨pre-change⟩); `FightingMove`/`AttackStyle` (Combat). Events raised: none. Events listened: none (it is driven purely by the 5 public calls below). *[changed: changelog #13]*

---

### 2. The pipeline, step by step (how one frame of animation is produced)

#### 2.1 Frame order

1. **Update phase (order 0).** `CharacterMotor2_5D.Update` integrates velocity/gravity, sets `IsGrounded`, updates `FacingDirection` and rotates the `Visual` transform toward it (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:192`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:199` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:181` ⟨pre-change⟩). `PlayerController.Update` / `EnemyBrain.Update` write `Visual.InCombat` / `Visual.Blocking` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:168` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:170`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:228` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:229`) and start attacks: `AttackExecutor.TryAttack` -> coroutine `Run` -> `visual.PlayAttack(...)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:131`) -> `FightAnimator.Attack` -> `Begin` (graph edit, no evaluation). Damage: `Health.TakeDamage` raises `Damaged` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/Health.cs:71`) -> `OnDamaged` -> `Attack.Interrupt()` + `Visual.PlayHitReaction` -> `FightAnimator.React`; lethal -> `Died` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/Health.cs:78`) -> `PlayKnockedOut` -> `FightAnimator.Knockout`.
2. **Coroutines** (after Update): `SquashRoutine` scales the `Model` transform (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:350`); `AttackExecutor.Run` continues (hit sweeps).
3. **LateUpdate, order 0: `CharacterVisual.LateUpdate`** (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:359`): flash + face (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:363` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:476` ⟨pre-change⟩), early-out at `dt <= 0f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:364`, so pause freezes the pose), then locomotion blends (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:376` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:378`), landing reaction (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:379` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:502` ⟨pre-change⟩), synthetic footsteps (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:390` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:394`), stance/block blend (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:396` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:399`), then `EnsureClips()` -> `DriveClips(dt, speed)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:520` ⟨pre-change⟩ to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:524` ⟨pre-change⟩) -> `FightAnimator.Evaluate(loco, Time.time, dt)` which sets all weights and times, calls `graph.Evaluate(dt)`, then corrects body Y / yaw and aims the head; back in `DriveClips` the jolt spring is added to Chest/Neck (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:453` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:458`).
4. **LateUpdate, order 100: `RigFollower.LateUpdate`** (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:95`): overrides the 30 finger bones, (coffee cup only) re-poses the right arm, seats the hand socket on the animated hand so the held prop and swing trail follow the clip.
5. Render. (The Animator component itself never evaluates: graph is `DirectorUpdateMode.Manual`, no controller.)

#### 2.2 Graph construction (FightAnimator constructor, once per body)

- `graph = PlayableGraph.Create(animator.name + " Fight");` + `graph.SetTimeUpdateMode(DirectorUpdateMode.Manual);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:87` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:88`), output `AnimationPlayableOutput.Create(graph, "Body", animator)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:89`).
- `layers = AnimationLayerMixerPlayable.Create(graph, 3);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:91`) - 3 layers, all Override blend (no `SetLayerAdditive` call anywhere):
  - **Layer 0 = `baseMix`** (`AnimationMixerPlayable.Create(graph, 6)`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:94`), weight fixed 1 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:108`). Inputs: 0 relaxed idle, 1 fight idle, 2 block, 3 walk, 4 run, 5 air (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:95` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:106`). Every clip is created through `Loop()`, which starts at a random time (`p.SetTime(UnityEngine.Random.value * clip.length)`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:135`) so crowds are not in lockstep. Foot IK is enabled only for the Mixamo fight-idle/block clips (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:133` `footIK || clip == set.fightIdle || clip == set.block`) and off for generated walk/run/idle (their foot-goal curves are enforced by test `Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/AnimationSpeedTests.cs:20`). The "air" input is a separate `Clip(set.run)` playable with `air.SetSpeed(0)` and `air.SetTime(set.run.length * 0.3f)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:103` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:105`): a frozen 30%-through-the-run frame.
  - **Layer 1 = `guardMix`** (2 inputs: `Loop(set.fightIdle)`, `Loop(set.block)`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:110` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:112`), masked with the `UpperBody` AvatarMask (`layers.SetLayerMaskFromAvatarMask(1, set.upperBody)`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:114`): Head + both arms + both hands only.
  - **Layer 2 = `actionMix`** (2 inputs, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:116` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:117`), unmasked, holds the two action slots (ping-pong). Slots are created on demand by `Begin`.
- `graph.Play();` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:119`). The graph is evaluated by hand every frame (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:334`).

#### 2.3 Base locomotion (clip-driven; weights procedurally computed)

Blend inputs come from CharacterVisual: `walkBlend` moves toward `Mathf.Clamp01(speed / 4f)` at `dt * 6f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:376`) (0 when airborne); `airBlend` toward 1 when not grounded at `dt * 7f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:377`); `stance` toward `fightReady ? 1f : 0f` at `dt * (fightReady ? 5f : 2.5f)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:398`) where `fightReady = InCombat || Blocking || Time.time - lastAttackTime < 2.2f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:396`); `blockBlend` at `dt * (Blocking ? 7f : 4f)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:399`).

In `FightAnimator.Evaluate` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:275` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:291`):
- `float onFloor = 1f - loco.air, stand = 1f - loco.walk;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:275`); `float running = Mathf.Clamp01((loco.speed - 2.8f) / 1.6f);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:278`).
- weights: Relaxed `onFloor * stand * (1f - loco.stance) * (1f - loco.block)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:279`); Fight `onFloor * stand * loco.stance * (1f - loco.block)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:280`); Block `onFloor * stand * loco.block` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:281`); Walk `onFloor * loco.walk * (1f - running)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:282`); Run `onFloor * loco.walk * running` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:283`); Air `loco.air` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:284`). They sum to 1.
- playback speed: walk `Mathf.Clamp(loco.speed / Mathf.Max(set.walkSpeed, 0.1f), 0.6f, 1.6f)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:285`); run `Mathf.Clamp(loco.speed / Mathf.Max(set.runSpeed, 0.1f), 0.7f, 1.5f)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:286`) with `walkSpeed = 1.9`, `runSpeed = 4.6`. Walk/run advance by the graph's `Evaluate(dt)`; their phase is NOT synced to the motor or to the footstep event.
- **Guard over walk (layer 1):** `layers.SetInputWeight(1, onFloor * loco.walk * Mathf.Max(loco.stance, loco.block) * (1f - 0.6f * running));` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:289`), with `guardMix` weights `1f - loco.block` / `loco.block` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:290` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:291`). So while moving in a fight the arms/head/hands show the fight-idle (or block) guard on top of the walk/run legs; fades to 40% at full run.
- Jump / fall: no clip. `loco.air` fades in the frozen run frame. Landing: no clip, just squash (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:383`) and the `Stepped` event (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:502` ⟨pre-change⟩).

#### 2.4 Actions (attack / hit reaction / knockout) - clip-driven, procedurally time-warped

**Starting an attack** (`FightAnimator.Attack`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:166` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:188` ⟨pre-change⟩):
1. `strike = set.For(style)`; none -> `return false` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:168` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:169`).
2. `preImpact = Mathf.Max(AttackPoses.ImpactTime(move.startup, move.active), 0.01f);` = `startup + active * 0.5f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:175` ⟨pre-change⟩); `postImpact = Mathf.Max(move.startup + move.active + move.recovery - preImpact, 0.01f);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:176` ⟨pre-change⟩). *[changed: changelog #13]*
3. Clip window mapped onto the move: `clipStart = Mathf.Clamp(strike.start, clipImpact - preImpact * MaxWindupSpeedUp, clipImpact - preImpact * MinWindupSpeed);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:179` ⟨pre-change⟩) so the wind-up plays at 0.75x..2.4x; `clipEnd = Mathf.Clamp(strike.end, clipImpact + postImpact * MinRecoverySpeed, clipImpact + postImpact * MaxRecoverySpeedUp);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:181` ⟨pre-change⟩) so recovery plays at 0.8x..2.2x; `clipEnd = Mathf.Min(strike.clip.length, clipEnd);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:182` ⟨pre-change⟩). `clipStart/impact/end` come from the builder's per-clip measurement (section 3.4).
4. `Begin(strike.clip, Kind.Attack, now, Mathf.Clamp(move.startup * 0.5f, 0.04f, 0.1f), Mathf.Clamp(move.recovery * 0.6f, 0.08f, 0.22f));` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:178`): fade-in 0.04..0.10 s, fade-out 0.08..0.22 s.
5. `slotGround[current] = strike.ground; slotYaw[current] = AlignStrikes ? Mathf.Clamp(-strike.landingYaw, -MaxAlign, MaxAlign) : 0f;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:179` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:180`).

**`Begin`** (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:242` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:261`): picks the free slot `next = current < 0 ? 0 : 1 - current` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:244`), destroys whatever was in it, creates a fresh `AnimationClipPlayable` with speed 0 (time is scrubbed by hand), connects it to `actionMix`. Crossfade: `crossfade = actionWeight > 0.01f ? 0f : 1f;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:254`) - if an action is already showing, the new one fades in over `fadeIn` against the old one (this is the combo flow); if not, the layer weight does the fade.

**Per frame** (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:293` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:332`): `t = now - actionStart`. Attack: `clipTime = AttackClipTime(Mathf.Min(t, total))` and `slots[current].SetTime(clipTime)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:303` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:304`) (two linear segments: `clipStart -> clipImpact` over `preImpact`, `clipImpact -> clipEnd` over `postImpact`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:265` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:266`); `alignRamp = RampAlignment ? Smooth(t / preImpact) : 1f;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:306`); big leaps are lowered: `slotGround[current] = strike.ground - strike.lift.Evaluate(clipTime) * (1f - strike.liftKept);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:308`); finish: `if (t >= total && !hold) kind = Kind.None; else target = hold || t < total - fadeOut ? 1f : 0f;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:309` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:310`). Combo hold: with `moreToCome` the layer weight stays at 1 after the clip end and the pose sits at `clipEnd` until the next `Attack()` crossfades in. Reaction: `slots[current].SetTime(Mathf.Min(t, actionClip.length))`; ends at `t >= actionClip.length`; `target = t < actionClip.length - fadeOut ? 1f : 0f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:314` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:288` ⟨pre-change⟩). Knockout: same time clamp, `target = 1f` forever (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:314` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:320`).

**Fade rates** (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:324` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:326`): `float rate = target > actionWeight ? 1f / Mathf.Max(fadeIn, 0.01f) : 1f / Mathf.Max(fadeOut, 0.01f);` `actionWeight = Mathf.MoveTowards(actionWeight, target, dt * rate);` `crossfade = Mathf.MoveTowards(crossfade, 1f, dt / Mathf.Max(fadeIn, 0.01f));`. Weights written: `actionMix.SetInputWeight(current, crossfade)`, other slot `1 - crossfade` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:329` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:330`), layer 2 = `actionWeight` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:332`).

Fixed fade values by kind: attack in 0.04..0.10 / out 0.08..0.22 (above); hit reaction in `0.04f` out `0.2f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:222`); knockout in `0.08f` out `0.2f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:231`).

#### 2.5 Post-evaluation corrections (procedural, on top of the clip pose)

- **Feet on the floor** (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:336` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:352`): `float needed = position.y + (sole - LowestFoot());` `groundedY = groundedYet && airborne ? Mathf.MoveTowards(groundedY, needed, dt * 3f) : needed;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:339`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:342`) - on the ground the rig root is re-placed every frame so the lowest ankle sits exactly on `sole`; in the air it eases at 3 units/s. For actions the clip's measured floor fix is used instead: `float actionY = restY + (acting + extraGround) * bodyScale;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:350`) and `position.y = Mathf.Lerp(groundedY, actionY, actionWeight);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:351`).
- **Strike alignment yaw** (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:354` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:361`): `yaw = actionMix.GetInputWeight(current) * slotYaw[current] * alignRamp` (plus the outgoing slot's), applied as `Animator.transform.localRotation = restRotation * Quaternion.Euler(0f, yaw * actionWeight, 0f);` - the WHOLE visible body rotates up to +/-70 degrees about Y so the limb lands straight ahead at impact. The logical hit sphere is still centered on `motor.FacingDirection` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:184`).
- **Head aim** (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:363` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:366`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:370` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:394`): `float aim = HeadAim * loco.stance * (kind == Kind.Knockout ? 0f : kind == Kind.Reaction ? 0.35f : 1f);` eased `aimWeight = Mathf.MoveTowards(aimWeight, aim, dt * 4f);`. `AimHead` measures the head's forward vs `Animator.transform.parent.forward`, ignores near-vertical looks (`level` ramp, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:381`), and turns neck 40% / head 60% about world up, up to +/-80 degrees.

#### 2.6 Hit reaction, knockdown/death, facing flip

- **Hit reaction** (clip + procedural): `CharacterVisual.PlayHitReaction` cancels any attack (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:330`), records `hitStart` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:302`), squashes the model 16% (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:304`), kicks the jolt spring (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:406` ⟨pre-change⟩), and `FightAnimator.React` crossfades to `hit_head`/`hit_body` (alternating) in 0.04 s (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:222`). The clip plays to its full length, then fades out over 0.2 s. Stun durations are shorter than the clip (player `hitStun = 0.3f`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:36`; enemy `hitStun = 0.4f`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:43`): after the stun ends the character can walk/attack while the flinch clip (about 1.2 s) is still on layer 2 at weight 1 (walking is hidden by the override layer until the clip ends or an attack crossfades over it).
- **Block hit**: no clip; only `joltSpring.Kick(axis * 10f)` + `Squash(0.07f)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:423` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:315`).
- **Knockout/death**: `PlayKnockedOut` -> `FightAnimator.Knockout` -> `knockout.fbx` (frames 30..148) crossfaded in over 0.08 s and held on its last frame forever. `CharacterVisual.LateUpdate` then runs only `DriveClips(dt, 0f)` each frame (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:366` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:370`). Enemies: collider off, drop to floor over 0.25 s then destroyed after `corpseLifetime` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:583` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:595`). A killing blow during an attack fires `PlayHitReaction` (React) then `PlayKnockedOut` in the same frame; `Begin` sees `actionWeight <= 0.01` so the knockout takes `crossfade = 1` and the reaction never shows (test: `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/DeathAnimationTests.cs`). No get-up, no revive: `knockedOut` is never reset.
- **Facing flip**: motor rotates the `Visual` transform (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:199` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:181` ⟨pre-change⟩). `FightAnimator` does not know about the flip except through `AimHead` (uses the parent's forward) and the strike yaw. The rig is a rigid child, so turning is a pop-rotation at 1440 deg/s with no clip (the procedural turn-ripple kicks at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:536` ⟨pre-change⟩ to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:545` ⟨pre-change⟩ are in the dead branch). *[changed: changelog #32]*

#### 2.7 RigFollower and held items (clip mode)

- `RigFollower.LateUpdate` (order 100) -> `ApplyFingerPose(rig, pose)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:101`): left hand = `fist[i]`; right hand = `Slerp(fingerOpen[i], fist[i], Curl(...))` from `HeldItemDisplay.CurrentGrip`; right thumb additionally rotated by `thumbRotation` in the grip frame (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:216` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:220` ⟨pre-change⟩).
- `if (ClipDriven)`: `Carry(rig, pose)`; then the socket is placed on the animated hand: `handSocket.position = rig.hand.TransformPoint(rig.grip); handSocket.rotation = rig.hand.rotation * rig.gripRotation;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:109` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:110`). Because the item is a child of the socket (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/HeldItemDisplay.cs:70`) with the fitted `ItemHoldPose` local transform, the clip's wrist motion swings the weapon.
- Carry arm (only `coffee_cup`): an analytic two-bone IK pulls the right arm to `carryPosition` (character-space) with elbow hint `carryElbow` whenever `CanCarryItem` is true; weight ramps 12/s; it yields to attacks, blocks, hits, KO, and any `FightAnimator.Acting` frame.
- The procedural pivot-driving loop (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:125` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:151`) is not executed in clip mode.

#### 3.2 AttackPoses: per-style header and per-key rows (all DEAD/UNUSED in clip mode)

Key args are `P(arm, wrist:, torso:, armOffset:, backArm:, body:, spin:, armSpin:, elbow:, backElbow:, kick:)`; `V(x,y,z)` = Vector3 degrees (metres for armOffset/body); `K(rearThigh, rearKnee, leadThigh, leadKnee)` = leg angles. Unset elbow resolves to 75/100 (windup), 35/80 (strike), 12/85 (follow); last strike key elbow default 5 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:103` ⟨pre-change⟩ to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:106` ⟨pre-change⟩). "arm" -90 on X points forward, -180 straight up (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:10` ⟨pre-change⟩). *[changed: changelog #13]*

Per-style choreography headers (27 rows): `swingTime` = seconds for the swing from wind-up into the strike (0 would default to 0.08f, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:440` ⟨pre-change⟩; the effective value is also capped at `impact * 0.75f`); `twoHanded` mirrors the weapon arm onto the off arm. *[changed: changelog #13]*

Per-key rows (89 key poses = 27 styles x windup/strike/follow, plus the extra keys of Whip, Golf, Stamp, Windmill, Spin, Hurl). The wind-up passes through every `windup` key during startup, the strike snaps through every `strike` key (last = impact), `follow` is the follow-through (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:53` ⟨pre-change⟩ to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:55` ⟨pre-change⟩). *[changed: changelog #13]*

#### 3.3 ItemHoldPose rows (17 props x 2 bodies = 34 poses; all WORKING, reachable when that prop is held)

Format: `pos` = item local position under the hand socket (metres), `euler` = local rotation, `thumbRot` = thumb opposition in grip frame (degrees), then curl triples (proximal, intermediate, distal; 0 open, 1 fist). All 17 props are referenced by at least one move (grep of prop ids in Scripts/Data). Two citations per row: the position line (covers pos/euler/thumbRot) and the middle-finger line (covers thumb/index/middle/ring/pinky). Body 0 = man, body 1 = woman (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/PropCatalog.cs:46`).

### 5. Execution order, double-writes, duplication

#### 5.1 Execution order

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RigFollower after CharacterVisual | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:16` | `[DefaultExecutionOrder(100)]` | Correct dependency: fingers/carry/socket must come after the graph evaluation in `CharacterVisual.LateUpdate` (order 0, default). `CharacterVisual` has no explicit order attribute, so the ordering relies on a magic number on the other class. HeldItemDisplay is also order 0 and unordered against CharacterVisual (harmless, it only writes item local transform). |

### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

**Dead / unused / partial (with evidence)**
- Procedural pipeline is dead in the shipped config but still compiled, maintained, and "tested": `AttackPoses` (27 choreographies, 89 key rows), `FightStance` (Ready/Block + 5 fidgets), `CharacterVisual` lines 525-783 + `PoseKnockedOut` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:882` ⟨pre-change⟩), `Spring1` entirely, 8 of 9 `SpringRotation`s, `Dangle`/tie/hair, `UpdateLook`, blink/brows, `RigFollower` pivot loop + `Rig.bones/drivers/offsets/weights/driverRest/boneRest` + `shoulderTravel`, the six dead locomotion tuning floats (`legSwing`, `kneeBend`, `armSwing`, `bobHeight`, `hipTwist`, `runLean`; `strideLength` is the one live float). Gate evidence: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:118`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:520` ⟨pre-change⟩; prefabs assign the set (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8057`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:5783`). Only `AttackPoses.ImpactTime` is live. *[changed: changelog #13]*
- `FightAnimator.baseGround` written 6x, never read (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:30` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:85` ⟨pre-change⟩ to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:90` ⟨pre-change⟩); 5 of 8 `grounding` entries therefore dead, and three (`Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:17797`, `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:17799`, `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:17801`) hold ~+1.0 which contradicts the ~-0.16 of the other clips. *[changed: changelog #15]*
- `CharacterVisual.Stance` property, `PlayHitReaction()` 0-arg, `PlayFidget` (invisible in clip mode; the reel test films a no-op, `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/AttackReelTests.cs:193` ⟨pre-change⟩), `UsesClips`/`PlayAttack(move)` (tests only), `RigFollower.RigCount/GetRig/Hand` (editor+tests only), `FightAnimationSet.StrikingBones/LandsExtended` (builder+tests only, live in the runtime assembly). *[changed: changelog #13]*
- `backhand.fbx`, `whip_crack.fbx` imported but unreferenced (searched guids + names). *[changed: changelog #21]*
- Face rig: `eyes: []`, `brows: []`, `tie`/`hair` null on both prefabs (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8037` to `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8040`): `UpdateFace` runs each frame as a no-op. *[changed: changelog #13]*

**Missing animation states** (nothing drives them): dodge/dash, jump/fall/land as real clips (frozen run frame instead), get-up/revive, enemy stun/winded/rally, ability cast, pickup, victory/taunt, turn, directional hit reactions, block-hit flinch (only spine jolt + squash).

**Suspected bugs / risks**
1. Hit reaction clip (about 1.2 s if 30 fps: `hit_head` frames 0..37, `Assets/_Project/Art/Animations/Mixamo/hit_head.fbx.meta:38`) outlasts the stun (0.3 s player `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:36`, 0.4 s enemy `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:43`); `Kind.Reaction` only ends at `t >= actionClip.length` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:287` ⟨pre-change⟩) and the override layer hides locomotion, so a character that can already move/attack shows the flinch. UNVERIFIED on screen. *[changed: changelog #12]*
2. Footstep dust/sound are driven by a synthetic phase and by the stationary procedural ankle pivots, not by the playing walk/run clip or the real feet (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:390` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:393`). Walk/run clips start at a random time (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:135`), so audio and feet never agree.
3. Dodge dash velocity (13 m/s) feeds `loco.speed` raw, so the dash plays the run cycle at the 1.5x clamp; knockback impulses do the same (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:374`).
4. `ClipDriven` is set once and never cleared (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:127`); if `EnsureClips()` ever fails later (Animator disabled mid-run) neither pipeline poses the skeleton.
5. `FightAnimator.Begin` destroys the older slot immediately (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:247` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:248`) even while it still carries crossfade weight: rapid reaction -> attack -> reaction sequences can pop. The attack-timing fields (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:59`) are single-instance, so a new `Attack()` overwrites the previous strike's time mapping while the old slot is still fading out, and the old slot is frozen at its last time because only `slots[current]` is advanced (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:304`).
6. Damage lands up to `active/2` earlier than the visible impact (hit sweep from `startup`, animation impact at `startup + active*0.5f`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:143` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:146`). Strike yaw (`landingYaw`, up to +/-70 deg, e.g. Sweep `-67.872154` at `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:6987`) turns the visible body while the hit sphere stays on `FacingDirection`.
7. `EnemyBrain.OnDamaged` cancels the visual attack even when poise >= 0.99 leaves the logical attack running (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:500` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:506` ⟨pre-change⟩); latent (max poise 0.85).
8. `PlayHitReaction` kicks `joltSpring` before `EnsureClips()` initialises it (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:406` ⟨pre-change⟩ to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:407` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/Springs.cs:43`): a character's very first hit loses its jolt if it has not yet had a LateUpdate.
9. Knockout is irreversible by design (`Cancel()` ignores it, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:239`; `knockedOut` never reset). Fine for enemies and the restart-on-death flow; blocks any future revive/continue feature.
10. Static mutable globals `AlignStrikes/RampAlignment/HeadAim` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:39`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:41`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:43`) are process-wide and are only toggled by tests.
11. Tests guard the wrong thing: `AnimationSpeedTests.NoAttackMovesTooFarInOneFrame` samples `AttackPoses`, not the clip time-warp; the real speed guard is the clamp constants at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:27` ⟨pre-change⟩. *[changed: changelog #13, #14]*

**Brittle / duplicated, candidates for rebuild**
- Collapse `CharacterVisual` to a thin facade over `FightAnimator` + `RigFollower`: delete (or isolate behind an editor-only flag) the 260-line procedural branch, `AttackPoses` choreography, `FightStance`, the 11 procedural springs, and the 6 dead serialized floats. Keep `AttackPoses.ImpactTime` (move it next to `FightingMove`). This removes ~1,000 lines, two "heavy" definitions, 4 easing copies, and the misleading tests. *[changed: changelog #13]*
- Move the Evaluate magic numbers (2.8, 1.6, 0.6 guard fade, 3 and 4 smoothing rates) and the per-kind fade times into `FightAnimationSet` so tuning is data, not code.
- Replace the synthetic footstep phase with animation events or foot-height crossing detection on the real foot bones, and give jump/fall/land/dodge/get-up a real state (add `Kind` entries or a small state machine) instead of one frozen run frame.
- Make reaction duration follow the stun (cut the flinch short when control returns) or lengthen stun to match.
- `FightAnimationSet` build-time helpers (`StrikingBones`, `LandsExtended`) belong in the Editor assembly; `RigFollower.Configure/#if UNITY_EDITOR` and the bone/driver arrays belong to the removed fallback.
- Four style pairs reuse the same clip with identical timing (Jab/SupermanPunch, Sweep/Backhand, Hurl/Toss, DiagonalSlash/Whip) while `backhand.fbx` and `whip_crack.fbx` sit unused: either wire them (`StrikeClips`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:26` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:37`) or drop the styles. *[changed: changelog #21, #22]*

**Open questions**
- Is the procedural fallback an intended low-spec/no-Mixamo path, or leftover from before the Mixamo integration? (The answer decides delete vs keep-and-test.) *[changed: changelog #13]*
- Should hit reactions be directional and/or interruptible by movement input?
- Are footsteps meant to be clip-synced (animation events) or cosmetic?
- Visual verification not possible in this read-only pass: fps of the Mixamo takes (affects clip lengths quoted as "about 1.2 s"), T-pose frame on body swap, and how noticeable the damage-before-impact offset is per move.

Method notes. Binary `.glb` files cannot be line-cited; facts derived from them were obtained by parsing the glTF JSON chunk offline with a throw-away python (read-only, no file written) and are tagged `[GLB-offline]`; the same numbers are re-confirmed through line-cited YAML (mesh `m_VertexCount`, material `_BaseColor`) wherever possible. Reference searches (for DEAD/UNUSED calls) covered every `.prefab`, `.unity`, `.asset`, `.mat`, `.anim`, `.controller` under `Assets/_Project` for the GUID, plus every `.cs` under `Assets/_Project/Scripts` for the name. Where a status says WORKING for a material it means: referenced by a prefab/scene renderer or a MonoBehaviour field (not merely present on disk).

### 1. Character looks

Important structural fact: the game does not have six independent character models. It has **two bodies ("figures")**, each a separately skinned skeleton, and the six Quaternius GLBs are used as interchangeable *head groups* and *outfit groups* on those two bodies. `Man` = skeleton from `Man_Suit.glb`, 3 heads, 3 outfits; `Woman` = skeleton from `Woman_Suit.glb`, 2 heads, 3 outfits. Total reachable combinations = 3 heads x 3 outfits (Man) + 2 heads x 3 outfits (Woman) = 15 head/outfit pairs, each with 6 skin tones x 6 hair colours chosen at runtime.

#### 1c. Every submesh of every look (59 rows; generated from the GLBs, the `.asset` YAML and the prefabs)

Tint = which runtime recolour list the renderer is in (`Skin`/`Hair` = CharacterLook lists, `Garment`/`Accent` = CharacterVisual lists, `Keep` = fixed material colour), replicated from `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:52` `static Tint TintOf(string file, string part, string material)`. Smoothness replicated from `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:80` `static float SmoothnessOf(string material) =>`. All parts are flat-colour (no UVs, no textures): `Glb.SkinnedPrimitive` writes only positions, normals, triangles, bone weights, bind poses (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:216` `mesh.vertices = vertices;`).

### 2. How looks are built and assigned

#### 2a. Editor pipeline GLB to asset to prefab (`Nine to Fight/Build Starter Content (Floor 1)`)

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GLBs are not Unity-imported models | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Art/Characters/Quaternius/Man_Suit.glb.meta:3` | `DefaultImporter:` (all six identical, guids `adfa4ad5c900ae445a6475e04b4c76e3`, `c21f267ccc1e26c4d9a29f182d1dc1af`, `0ea5f58495fdc7344891ba5634a804f9`, `afb095a761ab57d408ec36856f1f0028`, `de0ad7d4415882042b8abe41b669bf84`, `fe79b106c58b7e2448c3d334f53c3115` at line 2 of each .meta) | No glTFast/UnityGLTF package: `Packages/manifest.json` contains no gltf entry (grep `gltf` returned nothing). The builder reads the raw bytes itself. |
| GLB reader | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:23` `public Glb(string path)` | Magic check `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:26` `BitConverter.ToUInt32(bytes, 0) != 0x46546C67`; own JSON parser `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:229` `static class MiniJson` | Supports component types 5120-5126 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:130` `case 5126:`); only the first JSON chunk + first BIN chunk (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:30` `int binChunk = 20 + jsonLength;`). |
| Handedness conversion | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:21` `static readonly Matrix4x4 Mirror = Matrix4x4.Scale(new Vector3(-1f, 1f, 1f));` | X mirrored on positions `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:187` `vertices[i] = new Vector3(-positions[i * 3], positions[i * 3 + 1], positions[i * 3 + 2]);`; winding flipped `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:210` `triangles[i + 1] = (int)indices[i + 2];` | |
| Material colour import | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:158` `public (string name, Color color) Material(int index)` | Returns `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:164` `return (Str(mat, "name") ?? "Material" + index, linear.gamma);` | Only `baseColorFactor` is read. GLB metallic 0.4 and roughness 0.415 (men) / 0.272 (women) `[GLB-offline]` are ignored; smoothness is a fixed table (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:81` `material.StartsWith("Skin") ? 0.32f : material.StartsWith("Hair") ? 0.3f : material == "Eye" ? 0.7f :`). No emissive, alpha mode or texture support (GLBs have 0 images/textures `[GLB-offline]`). |
| Bone weights | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:195` | `Array.Sort(influences, (x, y) => y.weight.CompareTo(x.weight));` keeps 4 influences, renormalised (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:196` `if (total <= 0f) total = 1f;`) | Only JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:176` `var joints = Read(Int(attributes, "JOINTS_0"), out _);`). |
| Skeleton in bind (T) pose | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:299` `static Skeleton BuildSkeleton(Transform parent, string name, string file)` | Bone world transforms from inverse bind matrices `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:336` `var bind = Glb.ToUnity(meshSpace * Glb.Mat4(inverseBinds, k).inverse);`; feet re-parented to shins `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:344` `foreach (var side in new[] { "L", "R" }) bones["Foot." + side].SetParent(bones["LowerLeg." + side], true);` | Figure scale applied at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:303` `figure.localScale = Vector3.one * FigureScale;`. |
| Humanoid avatar build | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:368` `static Avatar BuildAvatar(Transform figure)` | 50 human bones mapped by name (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:348` `static readonly (string human, string bone)[] HumanBones =`); twists `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:377` `upperArmTwist = 0.5f, lowerArmTwist = 0.5f, upperLegTwist = 0.5f, lowerLegTwist = 0.5f,`; stretch `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:378` `armStretch = 0.05f, legStretch = 0.05f, feetSpacing = 0f, hasTranslationDoF = false,` | No toes/eyes/jaw mapped. Avatar asset is delete-and-recreated every build (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:247` `AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(avatarPath);`) so its GUID changes each build; prefabs are rebuilt in the same pass so references stay valid today (verified: Animator guids in both prefabs equal the current .meta guids). |
| Rest pose and fists | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:390` `static void PoseAtRest(Transform figure, Dictionary<string, Transform> bones)` | Arm splay `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:24` `const float ArmSplay = 4f;`; fingers fold 90/95/65 degrees (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:418` `Fold(bones[$"{finger}2.{side}"], knuckles, 90f);`) | Fist poses are held on top of every clip by RigFollower (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:205` `public static void ApplyFingerPose(Rig rig, ItemHoldPose pose)`). |
| Mesh generation | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:477` `static List<PartPrimitive> LoadParts(string figureName, string file)` | Part name = text after last underscore of the glTF mesh name (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:488` `string part = meshName.Substring(meshName.LastIndexOf('_') + 1);`); one mesh per primitive named `{file}_{part}_{material}` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:504`); all sub-assets packed in one asset (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:514` `AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(parts[0].mesh, path);`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:515` `AddObjectToAsset`) | Asset delete-and-recreate each build (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:513` `AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(path);`) = new GUID per build and large git churn (each .asset is 1.6-1.9 MB text YAML: `Man_Suit.asset` 1,861,311 bytes). 16-bit index format is used (`m_IndexFormat: 0`, e.g. `Assets/_Project/Art/Characters/Generated/Man_Suit.asset:1153`). |
| Shared materials per figure | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:505` `shared = Mat($"Char_{figureName}_{material}", color, SmoothnessOf(material)),` | 24 `Char_*` materials (13 `Char_Man_*`, 11 `Char_Woman_*`; rows in section 4) | Cached by NAME in `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:596` `if (Materials.TryGetValue(name, out var cached)) return cached;`, so two outfits with the same material name but different colours would silently share the first colour. Today no collision exists (checked: same-named GLB materials have identical colours across files). |
| Per-part recolour classification | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:52` `static Tint TintOf(string file, string part, string material)` | hard-coded string table, 7 Garment keys (lines 59-65) and 6 Accent keys (lines 67-72) | Brittle: any new GLB material needs a new hard-coded key or it is silently untinted. |
| Rig pivots and drive table | PARTIAL | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:171` `var drive = new (Transform driver, string bone, float weight)[]` | 13 invisible pivots (Chest, Head, ArmPivot, Elbow, HandSocket, ArmBack, Elbow, LegL, KneeL, AnkleL, LegR, KneeR, AnkleR; from `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:132` `var chest = Pivot("Chest", model);` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:144` `var ankleRight = Pivot("AnkleR", kneeRight);`), 16 driven bones with weights (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:173` `(chest, "Abdomen", 0.3f), (chest, "Torso", 0.65f), (chest, "Chest", 1f),`) | Pivots are the fallback procedural rig only; with clips active RigFollower returns before driving bones (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/RigFollower.cs:103` `if (ClipDriven)`). The HandSocket pivot is still live (held item). |
| Prefab assembly | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:410` `static GameObject BuildPlayerPrefab()` and `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:423` `static GameObject BuildEnemyPrefab()` | Both call `BuildOfficeWorker(root.transform)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:413`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:426`): so Player and Coworker prefabs contain the SAME two-body wardrobe (55 SMRs, 212 Transforms each; counted offline) | Wardrobe duplicated per prefab, not shared: every coworker instance carries both bodies (one inactive) and all 6 outfit/5 head groups. Heavy on memory for many coworkers. |
| CharacterVisual / RigFollower / CharacterLook wiring | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:213` `var cv = visual.gameObject.AddComponent<CharacterVisual>();` | `Wire(cv, "head", head);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:225` ⟨pre-change⟩) is the last pivot wired; `tie`, `hair`, `eyes`, `brows` are never wired by this builder (no `Wire(cv, "tie"` anywhere in the file); `SetArray(cv, "shirtRenderers", garments.ToArray());` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:216`) | See section 3.1: result is `tie: {fileID: 0}`, `eyes: []`, `brows: []` in both prefabs. |

### 3. CharacterVisual and CharacterLook

#### 3.1 CharacterVisual serialized fields

Defaults are C# initialisers; all Transform/Renderer references default to null and are wired by the builder. "Wired" cites the Player prefab line (Coworker.prefab has the same wiring at -2274 lines, e.g. `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:5763` `tie: {fileID: 0}`).

### 4. Materials

168 materials in `Assets/_Project/Materials` plus 3 in `Assets/_Project/Resources/FX`. Counts (script-verified): 162 Lit + 6 Unlit in `Materials/`; all 168 are accounted for below; **147 WORKING, 21 DEAD/UNUSED**. The 21 DEAD ones have no generator in the current builder (`StarterContentBuilder*.cs` search of `Mat(`, `MatTex(`, `MatGlass(` names), no GUID reference anywhere under `Assets/_Project`, and their last write is 2026-10-21 (generated material files are 2026-10-23 16:38): leftovers of the earlier procedural character builder (Skin/Hair/Eyes/Mouth/Glasses/Shirt/Tie/Trousers/Shoes/Belt) and of an earlier office pass (Carpet_Runner, Window, Window_Frame). Safe to delete (they are tracked in git, 336 files incl. .meta under Materials). *[changed: changelog #29]*

Grouping by generator: 80 literal-named (`Mat("...")`, rows with a `Mat("Name"` snippet), 33 Facade (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:390` `var mat = Mat($"Facade_{tint}_{tx}x{ty}"`), 24 Char (Man 13, Woman 11; `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:505` `shared = Mat($"Char_{figureName}_{material}"`), 3 Poster (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:678` `Mat("Poster_" + text.Split(`), 3 Sticky (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:449` `Mat("Sticky_" + notes[n]`), 4 Snack (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:569` `Mat("Snack_" + snacks[`), 21 orphans. I re-computed the expected colour/smoothness/emission from the builder source for all 80 literal-named materials and for the Poster/Sticky/Snack/Facade families and compared with the YAML: **no drift** (three apparent mismatches on glass were my parser reading the alpha float as smoothness; `MatGlass` default smoothness 0.95 matches). Colour spaces: YAML `_BaseColor` is the sRGB-authored value; Char_* values are `linear.gamma` of the GLB factor (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/Glb.cs:164`).

Notes column lists the renderer GameObject names that reference the material (xN = count) in `Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity` ("scene"), `Player.prefab`, `Coworker.prefab`, `*.prefab` props, or the MonoBehaviour field.

### 5. Textures (10, all procedurally generated, none hand-authored)

All ten PNGs are written by `SaveTexture` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:35`), which overwrites the PNG on every content build (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:46` `string path = $"{TexturesDir}/{name}.png";`) and then forces importer settings (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:51` `importer.wrapMode = wrap;`, line 52 `importer.sRGBTexture = sRGB;`, line 53 `importer.mipmapEnabled = true;`, line 54 `importer.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;`, line 55 `importer.anisoLevel = 4;`). Noise seed = `new System.Random(name.GetHashCode())` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:39`): stable only while Unity's Mono string hash is stable (it is, today), but it is not a documented guarantee. Every .meta shares these values (checked all 10): `TextureImporter` `serializedVersion: 13`, `enableMipMap: 1` (line 9), `sRGBTexture: 1` (line 10), `maxTextureSize: 2048` (line 34), `filterMode: 1` (line 37), `aniso: 4` (line 38), `alphaUsage: 1` (line 54), `alphaIsTransparency: 0` (line 55), `textureType: 0` (line 57), `textureCompression: 1` (line 75, default platform). Only the wrap mode differs: Repeat (`wrapU: 0`) for the 8 tiling textures, Clamp (`wrapU: 1`) for `sky_gradient` and `fx_soft_dot`. PNG sizes read from the IHDR (offline): see Values.
