### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

**Dead / unused / partial**

1. 21 orphan materials under `Assets/_Project/Materials` (Belt, Carpet_Runner, Eye_Sparkle, Eyes, Glasses_Frame, Glasses_Lens, Hair_Black, Hair_Brown, Mouth, Shirt_Coworker, Shirt_Player, Shirt_White, Shoe_Sole, Shoes, Skin, Tie_Coworker, Tie_Player, Trousers_Charcoal, Trousers_Navy, Window, Window_Frame): no generator in `StarterContentBuilder*.cs`, no GUID reference in any prefab/scene/asset/mat, last written 2026-10-21 (pre-Quaternius). Rows in section 4 are flagged DEAD/UNUSED. Note `Hair_Brown` in `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:56` is a GLB material name, not this asset. *[changed: changelog #29]*
2. `CharacterVisual` face and dangle features are dead on the shipped prefabs: `tie`, `hair`, `eyes`, `brows` are never wired (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8037` `tie: {fileID: 0}`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8039` `eyes: []`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8040` `brows: []`). Characters never blink, scowl, or swing a tie/hair. Either wire them (the Quaternius meshes have no eye/brow bones, so it would need extra rigging) or delete `UpdateFace`/`Dangle`/`tie`/`hair`/`eyes`/`brows`. *[changed: changelog #13]*
3. The whole procedural pose engine (from `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:525` ⟨pre-change⟩ `float calm = (1f - walkBlend) * (1f - stance);` to `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:782` ⟨pre-change⟩ `Dangle(hair, hairRotation, ref hairSpring,`, ~260 lines, plus `PoseKnockedOut`, `SetLegs`, `UpdateLook`, and the 13 pivots) is a dormant fallback: both prefabs have `animationSet` wired (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8057`), so `EnsureClips()` is true and `LateUpdate` returns right after `DriveClips` at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:369` `return;`. Six locomotion tuning floats (`legSwing`, `kneeBend`, `armSwing`, `bobHeight`, `hipTwist`, `runLean`) therefore have no effect in play. *[changed: changelog #13]*
4. `Woman_Blouse` head meshes (4 sub-assets, 674+4320+80+48 verts) are generated into `Assets/_Project/Art/Characters/Generated/Woman_Blouse.asset` but never instantiated (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:46` excludes `Woman_Blouse` from `heads`).
5. Public API with no runtime caller: `CharacterVisual.Stance` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:106` ⟨pre-change⟩ `public FightStance Stance { get { EnsureInit(); return fightStance; } }`), `CharacterLook.OutfitNames` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterLook.cs:121` `public System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<string> OutfitNames`), `CharacterLook.FigureIndex/HeadIndex/OutfitName`, zero-arg `PlayHitReaction()` (no caller anywhere), `PlayAttack(move)` (tests only), `PlayFidget` and `UsesClips` (tests only). Dead constant `SunsetAmber` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:25`). *[changed: changelog #13]*
6. No outline and no blob shadow exist for characters (searched); only real-time shadows.

**Suspected bugs / inconsistencies**

7. Accountant (Woman_Suit) gets no accent: the outfit has no entry in `accentRenderers` (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8049`), so `tieColor: {r: 0.18039216, g: 0.49019608, b: 0.35686275, a: 1}` (`Assets/_Project/Data/PlayerClasses/Accountant.asset:20`) only tints the swing trail; and the near-white `shirtColor` is painted on the black blazer `Body_Black`.
8. Coworker looks are not stable across sessions despite the class comment: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:151` ⟨pre-change⟩ XORs the seed with `GetInstanceID()` while `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterLook.cs:9` promises `so the same coworker always looks the same`. Also `Apply` is re-run on every `Configure` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:106`).
9. Offline emulation of the seeded RNG (UNVERIFIED in engine) says the Accountant and HR Rep get the same female head (`Woman_Dress` head) and both the darkest skin tone (idx 4), and Accountant gets grey hair: the two female player classes would look near-identical apart from outfit. Needs a visual check.
10. Footstep event positions use the fallback ankle pivots, not the animated feet: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:513` ⟨pre-change⟩ `Stepped?.Invoke(this, foot != null ? foot.position : model.position`. With clips driving, the pivots stay at rest, so dust/footstep FX may be spawned at the idle foot position (UNVERIFIED visually).
11. `Man_Casual` `Head_Skin_Darker` is tinted to the same colour as `Head_Skin` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:54`), losing its shading; `Woman_Dress` eyebrows ride on the eye material `Brown` and never take the hair colour.
12. Licence: `Assets/_Project/Art/Characters/Quaternius/CREDITS.txt:4` `Poly Pizza lists Woman_Suit under CC-BY 3.0` says Woman_Suit is CC-BY and needs credit "Quaternius" in the game credits; no credits screen string mentions Quaternius (searched `quaternius` in `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime`: no hit). *[changed: changelog #27]*
13. `UpdateFlash` end-of-flash loop (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:254` `Apply(renderers[i], baseColors[i]);`) has no null guard unlike `RefreshColors` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:210` `if (renderers[i] != null) Apply(renderers[i], baseColors[i]);`); fine today because the renderer list is captured once, but a runtime-destroyed child would throw.

**Brittle / worth rebuilding**

14. Character art is regenerated by delete-and-recreate (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:247` `AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(avatarPath);` and `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:513` `AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(path);`): new GUIDs and ~11 MB of text-YAML diff every build (the six mesh assets are 1.66-1.86 MB each). Consider keeping the GUID (overwrite in place) or importing the GLBs with a real importer (glTFast) and Prefab Variants.
15. Both prefabs carry the full two-body wardrobe (55 SMRs and 212 Transforms each, 70,727 skinned vertices instantiated per character = sum of the 55 mesh vertex counts, offline; only about 12-13K are active at a time, e.g. Man_Suit outfit 8,433 + head 4,902) - every coworker instantiates it. A single baked-look-per-spawn or a shared mesh library would cut memory/instantiation cost on later floors.
16. `TintOf` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:52`) is a hard-coded string table; `Char_{Figure}_{Material}` materials are name-cached (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:596` `if (Materials.TryGetValue(name, out var cached)) return cached;`), so a new outfit whose material name matches an existing one with a different colour will silently inherit the old colour.
17. `Mat()` never clears stale state: it enables `_EMISSION` when an emission is given but never disables it (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:615` `mat.EnableKeyword("_EMISSION");`), and existing `.mat` files keep old surface/keyword settings.
18. World textures are generated with `System.Random(name.GetHashCode())` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:39`); the visual result depends on Mono's string hash.
19. The skyline is 70 opaque cubes (bottoms at y = -90, z between 22 and 105) + 1 sky quad at z = 140 + 1 sun sphere, using 33 distinct material instances; one atlas material with per-tower property blocks would be cheaper.
20. Global post-processing uses the template's `SampleSceneProfile` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:261`), an asset outside the project folder that other work may alter. *[changed: changelog #45]*

**Open questions**

- Are eyes/brows/blink/tie-swing wanted at all for the Quaternius bodies (needs a texture-based face or blendshapes)? If not, remove the dead fields.
- Is the fallback procedural rig still required (e.g. for a no-Animator mode)? If not, ~700 lines in `CharacterVisual`/`RigFollower`/`AttackPoses` and 13 pivots could go. *[changed: changelog #13]*
- Are the generated `Art/Characters/Generated/*.asset` meant to be committed (11 MB text) or regenerated in CI?
- Neck/head seams between mixed head and outfit groups (e.g. Man_Hoodie head on Man_Suit body) were not inspected visually.

Idle-with-item pose for every prop (no per-prop idle arm pose exists except the cup): the Animator plays the shared clips `relaxedIdle` `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:15` `relaxedIdle: {fileID: 7400000, guid: 76a6868595a6571499eb9f79ac8a94de, type: 2}` (Idle.anim), `fightIdle` `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:16` (fight_idle.fbx), `block` `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:19` (block_idle.fbx); the item rides in the right fist with the fitted finger curls. Guard is held for 2.2 s after a strike: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:396` `bool fightReady = InCombat || Blocking || Time.time - lastAttackTime < 2.2f;`. The procedural `FightStance` poses (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightStance.cs:87` ⟨pre-change⟩ `// Rear fist held at shoulder height out in front, the item pointed up at the opponent.`) and the hand-authored `AttackPoses` are used ONLY when no animator clip set is available: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:520` ⟨pre-change⟩ `if (EnsureClips())` then `DriveClips(dt, speed); return;` (521-523). In normal play the attack look is the Mixamo clip per style (5.5), not `AttackPoses`. *[changed: changelog #13]*

Notes on the move data. `PlayerClass.BuildMoveSet` = class light/heavy/signature + `ClassMoveBook.For(name)` + `MoveLibrary.Shared` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerClass.cs:46` `var moves = new List<FightingMove> { lightAttack, heavyAttack, signatureMove };`, 47 `moves.AddRange(ClassMoveBook.For(name));`, 48 `moves.AddRange(MoveLibrary.Shared);`). `MoveLibrary.All` is consumed only as the default of `ProgressionState`: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:15` `moves = moveSet ?? MoveLibrary.All;`. The game always applies a class when classes exist: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:326` `player.ApplyClass(playerClasses[selectedClass]);`. Combo sub-styles come from `FightingMove.StyleForHit` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/FightingMove.cs:97`); the item stays equipped for the whole multi-hit move because `Show(move.prop)` fires only on `AttackStarted` (`HeldItemDisplay.cs:38`). `LeadJab` is thrown with the OFF hand and "the item stays on guard" (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/FightingMove.cs:32`), so calculator `number_crunch`, cable `ping_flood`, phone `speed_dial` hit with a bare fist, not the prop; `fiscal_year_end` combos Elbow/Knee/Stamp likewise. Unused styles: `Kick` and `SupermanPunch` have no move anywhere (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:355` ⟨pre-change⟩ `case AttackStyle.Kick:`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:400` ⟨pre-change⟩ `case AttackStyle.SupermanPunch:`; clips still mapped at `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:3034` `style: 21` and `Assets/_Project/Data/FightAnimations.asset:5011` ⟨pre-change⟩ `style: 26`). *[changed: changelog #13, #22]*

Move descriptions that promise throws but resolve to instant melee spheres: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/ClassMoveBook.cs:104` ⟨pre-change⟩ `"A thrown mug of concern. Heals you for 60% of the damage."`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/MoveLibrary.cs:46` `description = "Three flung memos (underhand, sidearm, overhand) that hit everyone in range. Nobody asked for this."`; hit detection is `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:194` `int count = Physics.OverlapSphereNonAlloc(center, move.radius, HitBuffer, ~0, QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore);`. No projectile is created by any player move. *[changed: changelog #39]*

### 7. PropIcons.cs (hotbar icons)

### 9. What "correct fit" means in the tests, and measured results

Definition (`Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/HeldItemFitTests.cs:288` `public void TheFittedItemTouchesSeveralFingersWithoutPassingThroughTheHand(string id)`): on the Coworker prefab in its original T-pose, for both bodies, the item surface is sampled every `SampleSpacing = 0.004f` m (38) within `Reach = 0.2f` (40) and measured against finger and palm capsules (`FingerRadius = 0.011f, PalmRadius = 0.014f`, line 32). Fails if: clearance `< -Tolerance` with `Tolerance = 0.0085f` (37; `HeldItemFitTests.cs:322`), thumb gap `> 0.006f` (323), or fewer than 3 digits within `0.006f` (324). It does not test: any animated pose (guard, strike), sleeve/glove meshes, the other four outfits, finger-vs-item interpenetration beyond bone capsules, or whether the item visually looks right. Companion tests: socket stays seated and does not rotate under repeated updates (`HeldItemFitTests.cs:119`), display uses the authored transform and updates on body change (163), cup carry keeps arm lengths (199), custom grasp opens only the holding hand (242). The PlayMode gallery asserts only transform equality and hand attachment, then saves stills (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/HeldItemGalleryTests.cs:82` `Assert.Less(Vector3.Distance(pose.position, item.localPosition), 0.00001f, label + ": fitted position");`); it pairs each prop with `moves.FirstOrDefault(m => m.prop == entry.id)` (62) so the capture state is the first move found, not necessarily the prop's own signature move.

Latest measured results (external evidence, Unity `Editor.log`, the last of four logged runs; decimal commas are the log's locale). Thumb must be <= 6,0 mm gap; at least 3 digits <= 6,0 mm; deepest penetration must be > -8,5 mm. All 34 rows satisfy the three rules (my arithmetic). Marginal rows: binder thumb joint -7,8 / -7,9 mm, stapler man thumb 5,7 mm.

### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

Dead / unused / partial

1. F1 `stapler` (and `MoveLibrary.StaplerJab`, `BriefcaseSwing`, `CoffeeSplash`) are reachable only when no player class exists: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:15` `moves = moveSet ?? MoveLibrary.All;`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:154` `if (Class == null && HeldItem != null) HeldItem.SetIdleProp(Progression.MoveFor(MoveSlot.Light)?.prop);`. Class play always replaces the move set (`GameFlow.cs:306`). Searched `stapler` (case-insensitive) and the prefab GUID across `Assets/_Project`. Decide: drop it, or give it to a class/enemy.
2. F2 Durability, weight, rarity, category, throw damage, breakage: not implemented anywhere (section 2). If the design brief lists them, they are missing, not misconfigured.
3. F3 Props cannot be picked up, dropped or thrown by the player. Only one projectile source exists (`EnemyBrain.cs:352`), only for ITSupport, never bosses. Moves described as thrown (`ClassMoveBook.cs:104`, `MoveLibrary.cs:46`) are instant melee spheres. *[changed: changelog #39]*
4. F4 `TrainingSeminar` pickup exists on Floor 1 only (`TowerDirector.cs` never spawns it); `Pickup.moveId` defaults to `keyboard_smash` on all five scene pickups. *[changed: changelog #41]*
5. F5 Styles `Kick` and `SupermanPunch` have authored poses and mapped clips but no move uses them (`AttackPoses.cs:355`, `AttackPoses.cs:400`). *[changed: changelog #13, #22]*
6. F6 `carryArm` exists only for `coffee_cup`; no other prop has an item-specific idle arm pose (everything else is the shared Mixamo idle/guard clip).
7. F7 Hand-authored `AttackPoses` and procedural `FightStance` are bypassed whenever the animator clips are active (`CharacterVisual.cs:520-523`), i.e. normally; maintain the Mixamo clip mapping in `FightAnimations.asset` instead. *[changed: changelog #13]*

Suspected bugs / weak spots (cited)

8. B1 Woman grips are not independently authored: man grip + (0.002, 0, -0.002) on 14/17 props, curls identical on 17/17 (`HeldItemGrips.json:8` vs `:50`). The guarding test is vacuous: `HeldItemFitTests.cs:27` `Assert.IsNotNull(field.GetValue(entry), ...)` can never fail. *[changed: changelog #28]*
9. B2 Fit coverage gap: fitting and tests use the default Suit looks; `Man_Hoodie` (ITSupport) and `Woman_Dress` (HRRep) player looks are never captured with items (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/HeldItemGalleryTests.cs:57`; class outfits `ITSupport.asset:21`, `HRRep.asset:21`). Sleeve/hoodie geometry vs grips is UNVERIFIED.
10. B3 Stale review artifacts: `Builds/Screenshots/GripReview/*.jpg` and `Builds/Screenshots/individual-item-grips.html` (2026-10-23) are ~2 days older than `HeldItemGrips.json` (2026-10-25 21:03); the HTML page therefore shows superseded grips. The `ItemFitting` and `HeldItems` PNG sets are current (regenerated 21:03 and 21:16-21:18).
11. B4 Marginal test margins: binder thumb joint -7,8 / -7,9 mm vs 8,5 mm tolerance; stapler man thumb 5,7 mm vs 6,0 mm (`Editor.log:8187`, `:8239`, `:8499`). A tiny grip tweak will fail these tests.

## Sections 6 and 9 (enemy half): Movement, Input, Camera, Enemies

Audited tree: `D:\Serban\software-projects\nine-to-fight`, branch `nine-to-fight-overhaul`, working tree on disk (not git history). Unity `m_EditorVersion: 6000.3.10f1` (`ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt:1`), Input System 1.18.0 (`Packages/manifest.json:8`), URP 17.3.0 (`Packages/manifest.json:10`).

How to read this file:
- All paths are relative to the project root. `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/` is abbreviated nowhere; every citation is full.
- "WORKING" means wired and reachable by code reading. I did not play the game. Where a PlayMode/EditMode test exercises a behaviour I cite the test.
- Serialized values (prefab / scene / .asset) beat code defaults. For every motor/controller/brain/camera field I give both the code default and the serialized value.
- Several serialized motor stats are overwritten at runtime (player: by `PlayerController.ApplyClass`; enemies: by `EnemyBrain.ApplyClass`). The overwrite is listed beside each affected row.

Script GUIDs used to locate serialized components (from the `.cs.meta` files): CharacterMotor2_5D `ce33c9de2f86d9f44bad0c291c65b6b6`, PlayerController `4b026fed886c290478c52966485b8e71`, PlayerInputReader `1d169079e7e9e634e821297aa4d97d40`, SideScrollCamera `a6aa394e0ca37ed44b7ae9310b211ee4`, EnemyBrain `c7c0995dc2c6c7a4c80add859905c946`, EnemyOverheadDisplay `e5c31809d1b3ea84d8a84285cb3441a1`, WorkerClass `5d56007b3c549a34f8f58d0ea87d4827`. Only three files in `Assets/_Project` (.prefab/.unity/.asset) reference those GUIDs: `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab`, `Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity`. The scene contains exactly 1 Player prefab instance and 8 Coworker prefab instances (`grep m_SourcePrefab` on the scene), and no other prefab sources.

### 6.1 Movement verbs (CharacterMotor2_5D + PlayerController)

Shared motor: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs` (one class used by the player AND every enemy, `[RequireComponent(typeof(CharacterController))]` at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:9`). It is a frame-rate-dependent `Update()` + `CharacterController.Move`, no Rigidbody, no physics layers.

### 6.3 Input (PlayerInputReader and who reads it)

**Key finding: `PlayerInputReader` defines every binding in code with `new InputAction(...)`. It does NOT use `Assets/InputSystem_Actions.inputactions`.** `ProjectSettings/ProjectSettings.asset:928` is `activeInputHandler: 1` (new Input System only), so the legacy `ProjectSettings/InputManager.asset` axes are inert and `UnityEngine.Input` is not usable at all. No other class in `Assets/_Project` reads `Keyboard.current` / `Gamepad.current` / `Mouse.current` (grep: 0 hits outside `PlayerInputReader.cs`).

Actions are created in `Awake` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:76`-`:94`), enabled in `OnEnable` (`:136`-`:139`) and disposed in `OnDestroy`. The reader sits on the Player prefab (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:10278`, no serialized fields). GameFlow reads the same component via `player.Input` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:173`).

### 6.4 Camera (SideScrollCamera)

File: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Camera/SideScrollCamera.cs`. One instance, on the scene's `Main Camera` (`Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:16068`; GameObject `m_TagString: MainCamera`, line 16054). It is a plain perspective camera moved in `LateUpdate` with `SmoothDamp` (no Cinemachine). Projection and lens, from the Camera component in the scene: `field of view: 36` (`Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:16122`), `orthographic: 0` (`:16123`), `near clip plane: 0.3` (`:16120`), `far clip plane: 200` (`:16121`), `m_FOVAxisMode: 0` (vertical, `:16102`), `m_ClearFlags: 2` (solid colour, `:16098`), `m_HDR: 1` (`:16133`), `m_AllowMSAA: 1` (`:16134`). Fixed pitch: transform rotation `m_LocalRotation: {x: 0.086514555, y: 0, z: 0, w: 0.99625057}` (`:16148`) = about 9.9 degrees down; code recomputes `Quaternion.LookRotation(framedLook - framedOffset)` every frame (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Camera/SideScrollCamera.cs:183`). No yaw or roll ever changes.

## Section 9 (enemy half): EnemyBrain, WorkerClass, overhead display

Prefab component: `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:890` (EnemyBrain), plus CharacterMotor2_5D (`:849`), Health (`:834`), AttackExecutor (`:877`), EnemyOverheadDisplay (`:907`). Serialized brain values (all equal to the code defaults): `workerClass: {fileID: 0}` (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:893`), `hitStun: 0.4` (`:894`), `laneTolerance: 0.45` (`:895`), `separationRadius: 1.1` (`:896`), `corpseLifetime: 2.5` (`:897`). Health on the prefab: `team: 1` (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:837`), `maxHealth: 30` (`:838`, overwritten per class), `hitInvulnerability: 0` (`:839`).

Where enemies come from:
- Floor 1: 8 hand-placed Coworker prefab instances in `Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity` (table 9.1). Each overrides only `workerClass`, name and position (no EnemyBrain field overrides in the scene).
- Floors 2-9: `TowerDirector` clones the first scene EnemyBrain as a template and builds a per-floor runtime copy of the WorkerClass (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:50`-`:55`, `:235`-`:269`).

### 9.3 EnemyBrain: state machine

There is no state enum and no behaviour tree: `EnemyBrain.Update` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:220`-`:265`) is a priority-ordered if-chain evaluated every frame, with per-role coroutines for special moves. The implicit states, in evaluation order:

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S0 Inactive (game not running or player dead) | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:225`, `:198`-`:202` | `bool canAct = GameFlow.IsPlaying && player != null && !player.Health.IsDead;` | Zero input, `Visual.InCombat = aggro && canAct && !IsStunned`. Covers Title, ClassSelect, Paused, Options, Ending and GameOver. |
| S1 Stunned / locked | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:231` | `Time.time < stunnedUntil` | Entered by: hit (`:501`), `Stun()` (IT Blue Screen `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:63`; wave arrival 0.6 s `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:173`), Support rally cast 0.9 s (`:378`), Charger missed = 1.4 s (`:368`). No decisions, no movement. |
| S2 Attacking | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:231` | `Attack.IsAttacking` | Input zero; lunge/knockback impulses still integrate. |
| S3 Dormant (unaware) | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:246`-`:214` | `if (!aggro) { Motor.SetMoveInput(Vector2.zero); return; }` | Stands still; no patrol, no wander, no idle behaviours. |
| S4 Role behaviour | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:260`, `:270`-`:332` | `if (RoleBehaviour(player, toPlayer)) return;` | Thrower keep-away/throw, Support rally/hang-back, Charger rush. Runs BEFORE the attack-token gate, so these roles ignore `MaxAttackers`. *[changed: changelog #9]* |
| S5 Boss slam | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:233` ⟨pre-change⟩-`:242` | `bossSlam != null && Time.time >= nextSlamTime && Mathf.Abs(toPlayer.x) < 7f && Mathf.Abs(dz) < 1.2f` | Also ahead of the token gate. |
| S6 Hold / circle (waiting for a slot) | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:245` ⟨pre-change⟩-`:253` | `if (Boss == Game.BossRank.None && !MayAttack(player.transform.position))` | Maintain stand-off distance and drift in Z. *[changed: changelog #9]* |
| S7 Swing (in range) | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:291`-`:261` | `if (inRange) { ... Attack.TryAttack(attackMove) ... }` | |
| S8 Approach | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:299`-`:264` | `Vector2 input = new Vector2(Mathf.Clamp(dx, -1f, 1f), Mathf.Clamp(dz * 1.5f, -1f, 1f)) + Separation();` | Straight-line steer to a spot `desired` in front of the player. |
| S9 Dead | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:570`-`:537` | `Active.Remove(this); ... GetComponent<CharacterController>().enabled = false;` | Terminal. `AnyDefeated` fires (XP, drops, floor-clear check). |

### 9.4 Spacing, surround, attack-token logic

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attack "token" (distance-ranked slots) | PARTIAL | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:451` ⟨pre-change⟩-`:463` | `public const int MaxAttackers = 2;` (`:31`) and `return closer < MaxAttackers;` | Not a real token pool. Every aggro, living, non-boss enemy that is not a Thrower/Support and is nearer to the player counts as "closer"; if fewer than 2 are closer this enemy may attack (ties broken by InstanceID, `:460`). Consequences: (1) at most 2 regular melee enemies press the attack; (2) there is no reservation, so the attacker set is recomputed each frame and can flip when someone is knocked back or stunned; (3) stunned and knocked-down-by-knockback enemies still count as occupying a slot; (4) bosses never count and never wait (`other.Boss != Game.BossRank.None` skipped, `:457`); (5) Throwers and Support units are excluded from the count, so a ranged enemy never "uses up" a melee slot; (6) Chargers consume slots when counted but their rush ignores the gate because `RoleBehaviour` runs first. Cost is O(n^2) per frame, fine at current group sizes. *[changed: changelog #9]* |
| Stand-off / hold distance | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:283`-`:252` | `float holdX = toPlayer.x - side * Mathf.Max(StandoffDistance, desired + 1.8f);` and `Mathf.Clamp(holdX, -1f, 1f) * 0.6f` | Waiters hover at max(3.2, reach*scale+2.15) m in X and back off if the player advances; they move at 0.6 of max speed in X, 0.5 in Z. Values: 3.2 m for Intern/Accountant/HR, 3.25 for IT, 3.61 for Middle Manager (derived, table 9.8). |

This is the whole "surround" behaviour: waiters spread over the lane depth but never flank to the other side (X side follows the sign of `toPlayer.x`). |

### 9.5 Roles (what differs behaviourally)

Generated archetypes inherit the role of their `baseId` (table 9.9).

### 9.9 Enemy class sheet: every WorkerClass field per asset

`WorkerClass` is a ScriptableObject (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/WorkerClass.cs:19`). The five assets live in `Assets/_Project/Data/WorkerClasses/`; each is 51 lines with the identical layout (top-level fields at lines 15-27, nested `attack` at lines 29-51), so a field has the same line number in every asset. All five are referenced from the scene (9.1). Code defaults for the fields come from `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/WorkerClass.cs:21`-`:49`. The `attack` block is a `FightingMove` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/FightingMove.cs:42`). Fields consumed by enemy code: damage, reach, radius, height, knockback, knockUp, hitStop, startup, active, recovery, lunge, moveMultiplier, prop, style, slot; `cooldown` is forced to 0 at runtime (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:165`); `hits`, `healOnHit`, `combo`, `unlockLevel`, `description`, `id`, `displayName` are inert for enemies (`id` is rewritten to `"enemy_" + workerClass.name`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:164`).

Dead-field check for the "DEAD/UNUSED" attack fields above: I searched `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs` and `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs` for `.hits`, `.healOnHit`, `.combo`, `.unlockLevel`, `.cooldown`, `.description`. `hits` and `healOnHit` ARE read by `AttackExecutor` for every move (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:124`, `:139`) but are inert for enemies because every enemy asset leaves them at `1` / `0`; `combo`, `unlockLevel`, `description` are used only by the player's progression/UI; `cooldown` is zeroed in `ApplyClass`. They remain legitimate FightingMove fields that a designer could use to give enemies flurries or lifesteal without code changes.

### 9.11 Floor archetype roster (what the class sheet is reused for on floors 2-9)

The generated floors do not add WorkerClass assets; they re-title and re-colour the five via `Archetype(baseId, title, shirt, tie, boss)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:13`-`:24`, themes `:80`-`:164`). A spawned enemy therefore keeps the BASE class's role, attack and speed regardless of title. Examples: "Sysadmin" is `Accountant` base so it is a Guard (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:125`); "Closer" is `ITSupport` base so a Thrower (`:120`); "Sales Rep" is `HRRep` base so a Support (`:118`); "Executive Assistant" and "Chief of Staff" are Support (`:149`, `:160`); "Board Member" is Charger (`:159`). Bosses: "HR Director" (`:101`), "Senior Counsel" (`:131`), "VP of Synergy" (`:152`) are MiniBoss on a `MiddleManager` base; "THE CEO" is FinalBoss on `MiddleManager` (`:162`). Every boss is therefore a Middle Manager body with the boss slam, forced to Brawler.

### 9.13 Comparison notes: how other brawlers handle attack tokens, spacing, lanes (short, web-sourced)

Limits of this research: three web lookups. They did not return developer-level documentation for Streets of Rage 4, River City Girls or Castle Crashers specifically; what I found is general beat-'em-up / action-game AI practice. The statements below come from search-result summaries, not from reading the full pages (one page fetch failed with a certificate error), so treat them as pointers.

- Attack-token pools are the standard way to cap simultaneous attackers: enemies must acquire a token from a shared pool on the target before attacking, which makes damage arrive in designed waves instead of random spikes, and pool size is a natural difficulty knob (a write-up of a GDC talk on DOOM describes larger token pools on higher difficulty; an indie devlog describes all-or-nothing integer token requests). See https://www.strayspark.studio/blog/attack-token-system-ue5-group-combat-that-feels-fair and https://lghts.itch.io/iron-reclamation/devlog/1092177/making-combat-feel-good-fair-readable-and-responsive-ai.
- A caution that matches this project's fixed `MaxAttackers = 2`: a GameDev.net thread reports a hard "about two at a time" limit felt mechanical with many enemies, and the poster replaced it with a size-based minimum-radius rule plus dodge chances. https://www.gamedev.net/forums/topic/701048-tactical-circle-system/ *[changed: changelog #9]*
- Readability principle repeated in the results: the player should be able to see who is engaging, who is flanking and who is waiting, with waiters arranged in rings outside the attack group. For Streets of Rage 4 specifically, the sources I found are reviews and tip guides that credit enemy MIX and placement (blockers, chargers, ranged/aerial types, overlapping attack timings) for the pressure rather than a visible turn-taking system: https://primagames.com/gaming/streets-of-rage-4-enemy-tips-and-tricks-guide/2 and the general article https://www.gamedeveloper.com/design/intelligent-brawling.
- Relevance here: this project already has role variety (Thrower/Guard/Support/Charger) and a waiting ring (circle + 3.2 m stand-off), which is the cheap part. The missing pieces are a real reserved token (so slots do not flip every frame), per-role pools (so a ranged attack does not compete with a melee slot, and a Charger rush does not bypass the cap), and a pool size that scales with floor/difficulty.

### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

#### Dead / unused / partial

1. `Assets/InputSystem_Actions.inputactions` is DEAD. It is registered as the project-wide action asset (`ProjectSettings/EditorBuildSettings.asset:12`) but no script reads it: all gameplay and menu input is code-defined in `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:76`-`:94`, and the runtime-created UI module uses the package's built-in `DefaultInputActions` (`Library/PackageCache/com.unity.inputsystem@57d0e36f6123/InputSystem/Plugins/UI/InputSystemUIInputModule.cs:1541`). Its Player map (Move, Look, Attack, Interact, Crouch, Jump, Previous, Next, Sprint) describes verbs the game does not have. `ProjectSettings/InputManager.asset` is inert (`ProjectSettings/ProjectSettings.asset:928` `activeInputHandler: 1`).
2. `SideScrollCamera.SetBounds` and `SetTarget` have no callers; the public `Shot` getter has no readers (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Camera/SideScrollCamera.cs:86`, `:63`, `:49`). There are no camera locks per wave/arena, so the camera never gates progress. *[changed: changelog #24]*
3. Slope/step settings on both CharacterControllers are configured but nothing in the scene uses them (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:10208`); scene furniture is non-solid (the scene file has only Floor + 2 end blockers as solid colliders).
4. No knockdown, get-up, sprint, crouch/roll, variable jump, retreat/flee, de-aggro, block chance, NavMesh: all searched, all absent (6.1, 9.6). `aggro` can never return to false (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:49`).
5. Inert FightingMove fields on all five enemy assets (`hits`, `healOnHit`, `combo`, `cooldown`) and `WorkerClass.role` (all `role: 0`, so the override path is unexercised).
6. Gamepad gaps: no A/South confirm in menus and no hotbar binding (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:88` ⟨pre-change⟩, `:122`); Start is both Submit and Pause, and Submit wins in Paused/Options (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:212`-`:205`, `:212`-`:213`). *[changed: changelog #16, #44]*

#### Suspected bugs (from code reading, not play-tested)

- B1 (medium): gameplay input is live while Paused/Options. `GameFlow.Pause()` only sets `Time.timeScale = 0f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:751`) and never disables control; `PlayerController.Update` has no GameState check (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:157` ⟨pre-change⟩-`:175`). While the pause menu is open, Q (`TryAbility`, consumes the cooldown and can heal/shield), J/K/I/U, L (dodge), digits (hotbar) and mouse clicks (Light/Heavy; clicking a menu row with LMB queues a Light attack) all still fire; attack coroutines freeze and resume on unpause. Fix: `SetControlEnabled(false)` in Pause/Options or gate on `GameFlow.IsPlaying`. *[changed: changelog #2]*
- B2 (low-medium): a Charger hit mid-dash keeps dashing and ignores knockback. `Motor.Dash` is independent of stun (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:181`; `Stop()` only on death) while `OnDamaged` stops the role coroutine and interrupts the attack (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:554`-`:500`): the charge becomes a harmless 7.5 m slide and the "WINDED" punish never triggers. *[changed: changelog #7]*
- B3 (design/bug): poise gives no hyper-armour. `if (poise < 0.99f) Attack.Interrupt();` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:500` ⟨pre-change⟩) means any unblocked hit cancels any attack, including the 0.75 s boss slam telegraph and a Final Boss with `poise = 0.85`. Bosses can be stun-locked by a light-attack spam (stun only shrinks to 0.06 s but the interrupt resets their swing each hit). *[changed: changelog #8]*
- B4 (medium): Support rally has no filter. It heals 25% max HP and gives +30% damage to every enemy within 7 m including bosses and other Supports (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:429`-`:398`). On HR floor 3 (HR Director boss with HR Rep crew) this can heal the boss every 6.5-8.5 s.
- B5 (low-medium): floor 1's scene Middle Manager is promoted to MiniBoss but does not receive the boss HP/poise/scale multipliers that spawned bosses get (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:105`-`:108` vs `:254`-`:257`), and it loses its Charger role (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:192`). Floor 1's boss is therefore the weakest boss in the game (140 HP).
- B6 (low): `MayAttack` counts stunned/knocked-back enemies as slot holders and flips every frame (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:451` ⟨pre-change⟩-`:463`); Chargers/Throwers/Support/bosses bypass the cap (`:224`, `:233`, `:245`), so "max 2 attackers" is not a guarantee: a Charger plus two melee plus a boss can all hit at once. *[changed: changelog #9]*
- B7 (low): jump pressed during an attack is discarded rather than buffered (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:184`), and `Attack.TryAttack` returns false while an attack is running (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:55` ⟨pre-change⟩): no input buffering for attacks at all, so mashing during recovery drops inputs. *[changed: changelog #23]*
- B8 (low): camera look-ahead SmoothDamp uses scaled time while position uses unscaled (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Camera/SideScrollCamera.cs:158` vs `:135`); the lead freezes during hit-stop.
- B9 (low, UNVERIFIED in play): IT Support department has `dodgeCooldown: 0.3` equal to the 0.3 s i-frames (`Assets/_Project/Data/PlayerClasses/ITSupport.asset:28` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:23`), so near-continuous invulnerability by chained dodges is possible. *[changed: changelog #17]*

#### Weak designs worth rebuilding, and why

- Enemy role selection by asset-name string (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/WorkerClass.cs:61`-`:67`) and floor rosters by `baseId`: every boss is a re-skinned Middle Manager, and renaming an asset silently changes behaviour. Make `role` a real data field per asset and let archetypes override it (the field exists and is already `Auto`).
- The AI is a single priority if-chain in `Update` with coroutines poking `stunnedUntil` and the motor. States are implicit, interruption rules are scattered (stun used as a "casting" lock for Rally), and there is no explicit enum for debugging or animation hooks. A small explicit state machine (Dormant, Approach, Hold, Telegraph, Strike, Recover, Stagger, Special) would remove B2/B6 and make tests possible.
- Attack slots: replace the distance-ranked `MaxAttackers = 2` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:34`) with a reserved token manager with per-role budgets (melee, ranged, special) and a floor/difficulty-scaled pool; keep the existing circle/stand-off for the waiting ring. *[changed: changelog #9]*
- Aggro is X-distance only, never decays, never alerts neighbours (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:241`); no reaction delay or perception. Group wake-ups ("the room notices") and de-aggro/regroup would improve pacing; aggro range 9-10 m wakes enemies 2-3 m before they are on screen (derived from FOV 36 at 12 m).
- Enemy motor feel: acceleration 60 / deceleration 70 on enemies (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:854`-`:855`) makes enemies snap, and player (5.2-7.2 m/s) outruns all enemies (2.6-3.8 m/s), so kiting is trivial except against Chargers/Throwers. Consider separate enemy accel and an approach speed ramp.
- No camera locks or arena gates (no use of `SetBounds`): the player can walk away from waves and bosses; All-Hands waves and boss fights have no containment and the camera clamp is the same for all nine floors. *[changed: changelog #24]*
- Input layer: code-defined actions are fine for a jam build but make rebinding, gamepad menu confirm (A), hotbar on pad, and holding/repeat in menus impossible. Either adopt the existing `InputSystem_Actions` asset (and remove the unused maps) or delete it and keep the code path; today both exist.
- Scene collision: furniture is purely decorative (4 solid colliders in the whole scene), so there is no cover, no blocking of throws by props, and enemies never need pathing. If lane obstacles are wanted later, the AI has no avoidance at all.

#### Open questions

1. Is gamepad meant to be first-class? (A to confirm, hotbar access, Start disambiguation.)
2. Should bosses be interruptible by light hits (B3), and should poise add hyper-armour or a stagger meter? *[changed: changelog #8]*
3. Should Support heal bosses (B4), and should the floor-1 mini-boss use the same multipliers as generated bosses (B5)?
4. Is the per-floor camera/arena lock intended to exist (SetBounds is written but never called)? *[changed: changelog #24]*
5. Is `InputSystem_Actions.inputactions` meant to be deleted, or migrated to as the single source of bindings?
6. Edge cases I could not verify without running the game: effect of B1 in practice (does the paused attack coroutine play on resume?), true on-screen aspect (affects the aggro-vs-visible-width claim), and the stick dead-zone (no processors are set on the Move action in code, so Input System defaults apply).

## 7. Combat and player classes (audit 07)

Scope: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/*`, `Player/AbilityCaster.cs`, `Player/PlayerClass.cs`, `Game/Combo.cs`, `Characters/Health.cs`, `Fx/HitEffects.cs` (combat triggers), the four `Data/PlayerClasses/*.asset`, plus the combat parts of `PlayerController.cs`, `EnemyBrain.cs`, `GameFlow.cs` (hit-stop / combo / burst), `GameFeedback.cs` (sound and FX triggers), `FightAnimator.cs` / `FightAnimations.asset` (style to clip), and the five `Data/WorkerClasses/*.asset` enemy attacks. Everything below was read from the files on disk (working tree), not from git history.

Conventions: `Assets/_Project/...` paths are shortened in prose only where no value is claimed. "Derived" numbers (slide distance, apex height, class-adjusted damage, total duration, Whoosh volume) are my arithmetic from the cited literals and are labelled `~`. Slide distance = `knockback^2 / 60` (impulse is a velocity in m/s decayed at `knockbackDrag = 30` m/s^2, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:193`, so distance = v^2 / (2*30)), poise 0. Apex = `knockUp^2 / 64` (gravity `-32`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:22`; `AddImpulse` sets vertical velocity directly, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterMotor2_5D.cs:104`). Lunge distance uses the same drag formula.

Row counts in this fragment: 45 moves (12 class-own + 20 ClassMoveBook + 5 MoveLibrary + 8 enemy), 27 style/clip rows, 4 class abilities (+4 ability kinds), 4 class stat rows, 10-row input map (x4 classes), 23 events/hooks.

#### 7.1.6 Input map (which key fires which move, per class)

Keys come from `PlayerInputReader`: Light = `<Keyboard>/j`, `<Mouse>/leftButton`, `<Gamepad>/buttonWest` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:89`); Heavy = `<Keyboard>/k`, `<Mouse>/rightButton`, `<Gamepad>/buttonNorth` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:90`); Special = `<Keyboard>/i`, `<Gamepad>/rightShoulder` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:91`); Super = `<Keyboard>/u`, `<Gamepad>/rightTrigger` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:92`); Ability = `<Keyboard>/q`, `<Gamepad>/leftShoulder` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:93`); Dodge = `<Keyboard>/l`, `<Keyboard>/leftShift`, `<Gamepad>/buttonEast` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:94`); hotbar = keys 1..9,0 and numpad (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:142`). Dispatch priority in `PlayerController.Update`: hotbar, then Light, Heavy, Special, Super (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:189`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:194`).

Slot keys call `Progression.MoveFor(slot)` = `BestMove(slot)` = the unlocked move of that slot with the HIGHEST `unlockLevel` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:63`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:70`), so an upgrade silently replaces the old move on that key; the old move stays on the hotbar. Hotbar index = position in the move set sorted by `unlockLevel` (stable): `return moves.OrderBy(m => m.unlockLevel).ToList();` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerClass.cs:50`; `HotbarMove(index)` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:78`. Unlock: `Level >= move.unlockLevel || trainedMoves.Contains(move.id)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:60`). XP: `40 + (Mathf.Max(level, 1) - 1) * 30` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/CareerLadder.cs:26` ⟨pre-change⟩), max level 10 (`Ranks.Length`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/CareerLadder.cs:22`). Locked hotbar keys toast "unlocks at ..." (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:247`). Pressed while an attack plays, the key is simply lost (no buffer).

#### 7.1.7 Style -> clip table (27 AttackStyle values, one row each)

`AttackStyle` has 27 values (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/FightingMove.cs:10`). Each style maps to exactly one `FightAnimationSet.Strike` entry (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimationSet.cs:85` `For(style)`), found by `set.For(style)` in `FightAnimator.Attack` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:168`); if a style has no entry, `Attack` returns false and no clip plays. All 27 have entries (`FightAnimations.asset`). Clip = Mixamo FBX under `Assets/_Project/Art/Animations/Mixamo/`. The builder's mapping list is `StrikeClips` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:26`). Clip playback is retimed so the clip's `impact` lands at `startup + active*0.5` (`public static float ImpactTime(float startup, float active) => startup + active * 0.5f;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:415` ⟨pre-change⟩), with wind-up speed clamped to [0.75, 2.4]x and recovery to [0.8, 2.2]x (`const float MaxWindupSpeedUp = 2.4f, MinWindupSpeed = 0.75f, MaxRecoverySpeedUp = 2.2f, MinRecoverySpeed = 0.8f;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:27` ⟨pre-change⟩). *[changed: changelog #13]*

#### 7.1.8 Props used by moves (PropCatalog relation)

`PropCatalog.Get(id)` maps `FightingMove.prop` to the held prefab (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/PropCatalog.cs:33`); `HeldItemDisplay` swaps to `move.prop` on `AttackStarted` and back to the idle prop on `AttackEnded` (`attack.AttackStarted += move => Show(move.prop);` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/HeldItemDisplay.cs:40`; `attack.AttackEnded += () => Show(idleProp);` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/HeldItemDisplay.cs:41`). The catalog asset holds 17 entries (ids at `Assets/_Project/Data/PropCatalog.asset:16`, `:45`, `:74`, `:103`, `:132`, `:161`, `:190`, `:219`, `:248`, `:277`, `:306`, `:335`, `:364`, `:393`, `:422`, `:451`, `:480`): calculator, ledger, audit_stamp, ethernet_cable, mouse, laptop, smartphone, golf_club, desk_phone, clipboard, binder, megaphone, keyboard, stapler, briefcase, coffee_cup, rolled_report. All 17 are used by at least one move (grep of `prop:` in all 9 asset move blocks plus `ClassMoveBook.cs` and `MoveLibrary.cs`); `stapler` is used only by the fallback Stapler Jab. Content test: `EveryPlayerClassMoveHasAnItem` (`Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/ItemContentTests.cs:26`). There is no item REQUIREMENT in the gameplay sense: moves do not need a pickup; the prop is cosmetic and attached per move, and the only learn-by-pickup path is the TrainingSeminar (`keyboard_smash` only, scene `moveId: keyboard_smash` `Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:23580`).

### 7.2 Class abilities (Q)

`AbilityCaster.TryCast` runs the ability of `player.Class.ability` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:26`). Cooldown applied as `ability.cooldown * CooldownMultiplier` (perk Paid Time Off `0.7^stacks`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:87`) via `Cooldown.Trigger(Time.time, ...)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:49`). Reset on class apply (`Ability.ResetCooldown()` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:110`) and each new floor (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:411`). Casting is blocked while hit-stunned or control-disabled (`if (!controlEnabled || stunned) {... return; }` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:157` ⟨pre-change⟩); allowed during an attack and during a dodge (`if (Input.AbilityPressed) TryAbility();` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:186` precedes `if (Motor.IsDashing) return;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:187`). On cooldown, a toast "X ready in Ns" is shown (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:148`). On any successful cast `GameFeedback.OnAbility` plays `Sfx.ComboUp` vol 0.8 (pitch jitter 0) and `Sfx.HitHeavy` vol 0.4 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFeedback.cs:111`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFeedback.cs:112`), generic for all four.

### 7.4 Systems

#### 7.4.1 Hit detection

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Hit shape | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:184` | `Vector3 center = transform.position + motor.FacingDirection * move.reach * transform.lossyScale.x + Vector3.up * move.height * transform.lossyScale.y;` | One sphere per sweep; `reach` and `height` scale with the attacker's scale, `radius` does NOT (`Physics.OverlapSphereNonAlloc(center, move.radius, ...)` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:194`). Facing is a ground-plane vector that includes the Z (depth) component, locked for the move (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:120`). Editor gizmo ignores `lossyScale` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:245`). |
| Layers | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:194` | `~0` layer mask, `QueryTriggerInteraction.Ignore` | No physics-layer separation; filtering is done by `GetComponentInParent<Health>()` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:197`). Only `Player.prefab` and `Coworker.prefab` carry `Health` (grep of the `Health` script guid in all prefabs/scenes), so no destructible props or environment damage. |
| Result buffer | WORKING (fragile) | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:18` | `static readonly Collider[] HitBuffer = new Collider[16];` | Shared static buffer; scene geometry colliders count against the 16 slots. In a cluttered area real targets could be dropped (UNVERIFIED in play). |
| Active window sampling | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:143`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:145` | `for (float t = 0f; t < move.active; t += Time.deltaTime) { Sweep(move); yield return null; } Sweep(move);` | Sampled once per rendered frame (frame-rate dependent: `active: 0.08` is ~5 sweeps + 1 at 60 fps) and uses scaled `Time.deltaTime`, so it stretches during hit-stop. |
| Per-swing dedupe | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:199` | `if (!alreadyHit.Add(target)) continue;` | Added BEFORE `TakeDamage`, so a target that is invulnerable at first contact is consumed for the whole swing (see Findings). Cleared at every hit of a flurry (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:118`). |

A launched enemy above ~1.8 m is out of reach of a radius-0.6 sphere. |

#### 7.4.2 Damage formula

Player hit on an enemy (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:204`):
`amount = move.damage * DamageMultiplier * BuffDamageMultiplier * PerkDamageMultiplier * (crit ? 2f : 1f)`.

| Term | Source | Value |
|---|---|---|
| `move.damage` | move tables above | per move |
| `DamageMultiplier` | `PlayerClass.damageMultiplier` via `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:100` | 1 / 1.05 / 0.9 / 1.15 (default `1f` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:36`); enemies keep 1 |
| `BuffDamageMultiplier` | Hustle `damageMultiplier: 1.3` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:74`); enemy Rally `other.Attack.BuffDamageMultiplier = 1.3f;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:436`) | default `1f` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:38` |
| `PerkDamageMultiplier` | Stock Options `1f + 0.15f * Stacks(PerkId.StockOptions)` (max 3 stacks, additive) `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:81`; pushed in `ApplyPerks` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:123` | 1 .. 1.45 |
| crit | `CritChance` = Corner Desk `0.15f * Stacks` (max 3 stacks = 45%) `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:88`; roll `UnityEngine.Random.value < CritChance` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:167` | x2 damage, hit-stop x1.6 |
| Target-side | Guard: x0.15 (light, front) or x1.2 (heavy, guard break) `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:462`, `:428`; no armor, resistance or defense stat on the player or enemies | |
| Lifesteal / heal | `float heal = move.healOnHit + Lifesteal; if (heal > 0f) self.Heal(info.amount * heal);` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:174`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:175` | Expense Account `0.06f * Stacks` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:84`. Uses the pre-guard `info.amount` (struct copy), per target hit. |
| Difficulty setting | none | No difficulty/damage-taken multiplier exists in `GameSettings` (`Id { MasterVolume, MusicVolume, EffectsVolume, ScreenShake, DamageNumbers, Hints, Fullscreen, VSync }` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameSettings.cs:9`). |

Enemy-side scaling (floor 2+ only; floor 1 uses scene-placed assets): `healthScale = 1f + 0.2f * (floor - 1)` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:214`; `damageScale = 1f + 0.1f * (floor - 1)` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:215`; Review Week event `plan.damageScale *= 1.25f;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:319`; Casual Friday `plan.healthScale *= 0.65f;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:305`; applied `w.attack.damage *= plan.damageScale;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:261`; elite "Senior" `worker.attack.damage *= 1.15f;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:232` and `worker.maxHealth *= 1.8f;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:228`; Final boss `w.attack.damage *= 1.3f;` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:284`; attack cooldown shrinks to 0.75x by the top floor `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:263`. Enemy damage to the player is the raw `damage` of the (scaled) attack: enemy `DamageMultiplier` is 1, there is no mitigation, and the player's `Health.ModifyIncoming` is unset (only `EnemyBrain` sets it, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:109`).

#### 7.4.9 Friendly fire

None for the damage paths: `AttackExecutor` skips same-team targets (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:198`), `Projectile` skips same-team targets (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/Projectile.cs:83` ⟨pre-change⟩), Blue Screen and Hostile Takeover only iterate `EnemyBrain.Active` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:59`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:624`). A thrown item passes through other enemies. Enemy support Rally heals/buffs allies only (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:429`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:439`). Team is a 2-value enum (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/Health.cs:6`); there is no neutral or co-op player team.

### 7.7 Comparison notes (brawler conventions; short)

- Streets of Rage 4 patch notes show how a mature brawler handles the same knobs: per-move invincibility at the start of specials/blitz, "jump cancel" after a combo's 3rd hit or first kick hit, juggle fixes (an infinite Max back-attack juggle was patched), and per-move "hit freeze" tuning (Axel's neutral special got less hit freeze). https://www.thesixthaxis.com/2020/09/07/streets-of-rage-4-patch-1-03-1-04-ps4-xb1-pc-update/ (patch notes, not a systems guide). Takeaway for this project: cancel windows, per-move startup i-frames and juggle limits are data on the move, not global.
- River City Girls 2 shipped a balance update that "primarily adjusts hitstop" to make combos and juggles friendlier, i.e. hit-stop is tuned per hit to enable links rather than as a pure impact effect. https://co-optimus.com/article/17352/river-city-girls-2-gets-a-balance-update-to-improve-combos-and-juggles.html . A generic definition of air-juggle deterioration (juggling gets harder as hits accumulate) is in https://ufe3d.com/doku.php/global:combo . I did not find a primary source for Castle Crashers' or River City Girls (1) hitstun decay values.
- Sifu's defence design: blocking fills a Structure gauge, parries do not and damage the enemy's Structure, dodge windows are more forgiving than parry windows, and no single defence answers every attack. https://blog.playstation.com/?p=356872 and https://steventus.substack.com/p/deep-design-dive-sifu . Contrast: here the player has dodge-with-i-frames only (no block, no parry, no meter), so "defence" is a single button with a 0.3 s window.

**Suspected bugs (cited)**

1. Blue Screen / winded / rally stun is clobbered by the first hit: `stunnedUntil = Time.time + hitStun * (1f - poise);` assigns instead of taking the max (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:501` ⟨pre-change⟩), while `Stun()` uses `Mathf.Max` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:94`). IT Support's "freeze for 2 seconds" (`Assets/_Project/Data/PlayerClasses/ITSupport.asset:104`, real value `duration: 2.2` at `:110`) is reduced to 0.4 s as soon as it is hit. Also a Charger's 1.4 s "WINDED" window (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:404`). *[changed: changelog #6]*
2. AoE "shockwave" moves (Mandatory Training, Disciplinary Action, Mass Layoff, rm -rf, Tax Bracket) knock every target along the attacker's facing, not outward: `knockback = motor.FacingDirection * move.knockback + Vector3.up * move.knockUp,` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:132` ⟨pre-change⟩). Enemies standing behind the player are shoved into/through the player. The perk text "Huge knockback keeps crowds back" (`Assets/_Project/Data/PlayerClasses/HRRep.asset:18`) is only true for the front half. *[changed: changelog #5]*
3. Input is not gated while paused: `GameFlow.Pause()` sets `Time.timeScale = 0f` but never calls `SetControlEnabled(false)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:747`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:755`), and `PlayerController.Update` only checks `controlEnabled` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:157` ⟨pre-change⟩). Light/Heavy/Special/Super/Q/hotbar presses during the pause menu would start attacks (frozen in startup, whoosh plays) or cast Q (Tax Refund heal). UNVERIFIED in play. *[changed: changelog #2]*
4. IT Support near-permanent i-frames: `dodgeCooldown: 0.3` (`Assets/_Project/Data/PlayerClasses/ITSupport.asset:28` ⟨pre-change⟩) equals `dodgeInvulnerability: 0.3` (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:10310`); cooldown is stamped at the press and the dodge is allowed during any attack frame, so spamming Dodge chains invulnerability (and Flex Time makes the windows overlap). *[changed: changelog #17]*
5. A boss telegraph can be cancelled by any hit: the boss slam has `bossSlam.startup = 0.75f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:146`) but `Attack.Interrupt()` runs on every hit unless `poise >= 0.99` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:500` ⟨pre-change⟩); boss poise is 0.7 / 0.85 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:276`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:282`), which only shortens the stun (0.06 s at 0.85). No super-armour on telegraphed attacks.
6. Hit-stop order dependence: only the first `HitStop` request is honoured (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:728` ⟨pre-change⟩), and the buffer order is arbitrary (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:194`), so in an AoE that includes a blocking guard (hitStop forced to `0.02f`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:468`) the whole hit can freeze for 0.02 s instead of the move's 0.14 s.
7. Heal-on-hit scales with target count and uses pre-guard damage: `self.Heal(info.amount * heal)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:175`), `healOnHit: 0.6f` on Wellness Check (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/ClassMoveBook.cs:105` ⟨pre-change⟩) heals 12.6 HP per target hit; Expense Account lifesteal heals from blocked hits at full value. Overkill damage also fully heals.
8. `alreadyHit.Add(target)` happens before `TakeDamage` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:199`, `:138`): a swing that first touches a target during its i-frames is consumed for the rest of that swing, even if the i-frames end mid-window.
9. `HitBuffer` of 16 colliders on layer mask `~0` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:18`, `:121`) includes scene colliders; in dense areas real targets could be skipped. UNVERIFIED.
10. Description/asset drift: Blue Screen text "2 seconds" vs `duration: 2.2`.
11. A flurry's knockback pushes the target away between hits (the play-test works around it: `// A heavy-poise target so the knockback doesn't carry it out of range between hits` `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/CareerMovePlayTests.cs:38`), and Ping Flood (radius 0.55, kb 1.5) is the only flurry designed not to. Hits 2+ of Number Crunch / Speed Dial can whiff in play.

**Weak / brittle designs worth rebuilding**

1. Move data lives in three incompatible formats: serialized asset fields (12 + 5 moves), a 22-positional-argument C# factory `M(...)` (20 moves, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/ClassMoveBook.cs:12`) and static initialisers (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/MoveLibrary.cs:11`). Designers cannot tune book moves in the inspector; positional floats (`11f, 1f, 0.75f, 5f, 1f, 0.14f, 0.08f, 0.14f`) are easy to misorder. Rebuild as one ScriptableObject per move (or one move table) with validation.
2. `AttackExecutor` is a coroutine with `WaitForSeconds`: no state machine, no frame-accurate hitboxes, no cancel windows, no input buffer, active window sampled per rendered frame and stretched by hit-stop. This is why combat feels like "commit, then wait". Rebuild around a fixed-step state machine (startup / active / recovery) with cancel tables (hit-confirm cancel into next normal, special-cancel, dodge-cancel only on recovery), a 5-8 frame input buffer, and a light-attack string (J-J-J-finisher) instead of one repeatable single hit. *[changed: changelog #23]*
3. Upgrades replace instead of extend: at Lv5 the Light key swaps from a 0.33 s single jab to a 1.1 s three-hit commit (Number Crunch total `1.11s`), and every hit of a flurry pays a full startup (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:133`). The quickest poke is demoted to hotbar key 1.
4. One sphere per move, always facing-directed knockback, no hurtbox/hitbox split, no per-hit data inside a flurry (hits differ only in animation style), no vertical/air logic. Needs per-hit hitbox + launch vector (radial option) for shockwaves.
5. Global hit-stop through `Time.timeScale = 0.05` freezes the whole world and is single-slot (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:823`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:748` ⟨pre-change⟩). A per-actor hit-pause (attacker + victim animator speed) avoids dropped requests and lets multi-hit AoEs feel right.
6. Defence is a single dodge button with generous i-frames; no block, parry or guard meter for the player, while enemies have a hard-coded guard rule on one role. `DamageInfo.heavy` is a binary derived from the move slot, not from the move.
7. Stun is a bare timestamp written from several systems with inconsistent semantics (assign vs max) (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:94`, `:368`, `:378`, `:501`); there is no status/CC layer, no poise break meter, no armour frames.
8. `AbilityCaster` is an enum switch with hard-coded VFX sizes (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:50`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:84`), so each new ability needs code; `ClassAbility` carries fields that are dead for 3 of 4 kinds.
9. Sound is generic: one Whoosh (volume only), two hit sounds split at a 14-damage threshold, and no per-move or per-prop sound; FX is also tiered by damage only (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFeedback.cs:14`). Enemy swings are silent.
10. Combo meter rewards only XP; it counts blocked and multi-target hits and has no damage scaling, no hitstun decay and no juggle limit, so long combos are cheap to farm with AoE moves.

**Open questions**

- Is the player supposed to be able to attack, cast Q and dodge while the pause/options menu is up (see bug 3)? Needs an in-editor check.
- Does the Shield ability's block pose layer correctly while swinging (`Visual.Blocking` + attack clip)? Not covered by `HRFormalComplaintBlocksDamage`.
- Intended difficulty model: there is no difficulty setting and no damage-taken multiplier; floor scaling is +20% HP / +10% damage per floor (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:214`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:215`). Confirm that is deliberate.
- Floor 1 mini-bosses are scene-placed MiddleManagers promoted at Start (`enemy.Configure(enemy.WorkerClass, BossRank.MiniBoss);` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:107` ⟨pre-change⟩) and do NOT receive the +2.2x HP / poise 0.7 mini-boss scaling that `BuildWorker` applies on later floors (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:273`-`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:278`); they keep `maxHealth: 140` and `poise: 0.55` from the asset. Is that intended?
- Training Seminar pickups all teach `keyboard_smash` (scene `moveId: keyboard_smash` `Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:23580`); giving a Lv1 character a 38-damage Super (cooldown 4 s) is a large power spike. Intended?
- Statuses are code-read only; apart from the cited play tests (`FiscalYearEndHitsFourTimesAndHeals`, four ability tests) I did not run the game, so every WORKING means "wired and reachable by code path", not "play-verified".

#### 10.1e Input bindings that drive flow (all defined in code)

- Submit: `"<Keyboard>/enter", "<Keyboard>/numpadEnter", "<Gamepad>/start"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:88` ⟨pre-change⟩). *[changed: changelog #16]*
- Restart: `"<Keyboard>/r", "<Gamepad>/select"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:105`).
- Pause: `"<Keyboard>/escape", "<Keyboard>/p", "<Gamepad>/start"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:106`). *[changed: changelog #16]*
- Mute: `"<Keyboard>/m"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:107`).
- Cancel: `"<Keyboard>/escape", "<Keyboard>/backspace", "<Gamepad>/buttonEast"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:108`).
- Menu navigation threshold `NavigateThreshold = 0.5f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:10`).
- Gamepad Start is bound to both Submit and Pause, so in Paused/Options it acts as Submit first (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:212`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:220`) - see Findings. *[changed: changelog #16]*

### 10.2 Floors (TowerPlan and Floor 1)

Tower size: `public const int FloorCount = 9;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:82`). Floor 1 is the hand-built scene; `Build()` returns an empty plan for it: `if (theme.crew == null) return plan; // floor 1 uses the hand-placed scene layout` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:218`). Floors 2-9 re-use the same room: `TowerDirector.Stage` spawns coworkers/pickups, re-tints lights and carpet and repaints the wall signs (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:119`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:148`). The lobby sign text is rewritten as `$"FLOOR {plan.number}  ·  {plan.name.ToUpperInvariant()}"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:150`) and `"CORNER OFFICE: THIS WAY"` / `"CORNER OFFICE: {left} FLOOR(S) UP"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:154`).

### 10.3 Waves, enemy selection and difficulty scaling

#### 10.3b Difficulty scaling - exact formulas

Let `f` = floor number (1..9). All applied in `TowerPlan.Build` (plan scales) and `TowerDirector.BuildWorker`/`SpawnCoworker` (per-coworker copy of the WorkerClass, not the asset).

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HP scale | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:214` | `healthScale = 1f + 0.2f * (floor - 1),` -> `w.maxHealth *= plan.healthScale;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:253`) | 1.0 ... 2.6 on F9. |
| Damage scale | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:215` | `damageScale = 1f + 0.1f * (floor - 1),` -> `w.attack.damage *= plan.damageScale;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:261`) | 1.0 ... 1.8. |
| XP scale | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:216` | `xpScale = 1f + 0.15f * (floor - 1),` -> `w.xpReward = Mathf.RoundToInt(w.xpReward * plan.xpScale);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:254`) | 1.0 ... 2.2. |
| Attack cooldown | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:263` | `w.attackCooldown *= Mathf.Lerp(1f, 0.75f, (plan.number - 1) / (float)(TowerPlan.FloorCount - 1));` | Linear 1.0 (F1) to 0.75 (F9). |
| Aggro range | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:262` | `w.aggroRange = Mathf.Max(w.aggroRange, 10f);` | |

#### 10.3d Floor events (modifiers) - one row per event

Eligibility: `if (floor <= 1 || Themes[Mathf.Clamp(floor, 1, FloorCount) - 1].hasBoss) return FloorEvent.None;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:291`) -> only floors 2, 4, 5, 7 can roll one (boss floors 3, 6, 8, 9 and floor 1 never). The pool is the 6 non-None `FloorEvent` values minus those already used this climb, uniform (`pool[rng.Next(pool.Count)]`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:295`); an event is never repeated within a climb (`used.Contains`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:294`; `usedEvents?.Add(floorEvent)` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:127`). Enum: `public enum FloorEvent { None, CasualFriday, ReviewWeek, FireDrill, PowerOutage, AllHands, PizzaParty }` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:10`). So a full climb sees at most 4 of the 6 events.

### 10.4 Ranks (CareerLadder) - one row per rank

XP formula: `public static int XpToNextLevel(int level) => 40 + (Mathf.Max(level, 1) - 1) * 30;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/CareerLadder.cs:26` ⟨pre-change⟩). Level cap `MaxLevel => Ranks.Length` = 10 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/CareerLadder.cs:22`). "Promotion threshold" = XP needed to leave that rank. Cumulative XP from a fresh start is computed. Every promotion grants: full heal and +`healthPerLevel` max HP (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/PlayerProgression.cs:57`, `SetMax(..., true)`), the `"Promoted!"` banner (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:130`) + `Sfx.Promote` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFeedback.cs:107`), and the class/shared move whose `unlockLevel` equals the new level (see 10.6).

### 10.5 Perks (PerkLibrary) - one row per perk

Offering rules: `Roll(System.Random rng, int count, PerkSet owned)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:46`) filters out perks whose stacks reached `maxStacks` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:48`), then draws `count` distinct perks uniformly (`int i = rng.Next(pool.Count);` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:52`). `count` is hard-coded 3 (`PerkLibrary.Roll(runRng, 3, player.Perks)`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:667` ⟨pre-change⟩). Offered once per non-final floor at the elevator (floors 1-8, so at most 8 picks per climb); the player must take one (`ChoosePerk(perkChoice)`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:467`). No rarity tiers exist: the `Perk` class has only `id, name, description, maxStacks, color` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:14`); default `public int maxStacks = 3;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:18`). No reroll, skip or banish. Perks last for the climb only (the `PerkSet` lives on the scene's PlayerController, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:60`, and is rebuilt on scene reload). Total stack capacity = 28 (3+3+2+2+3+2+3+2+3+1+2+2, computed). Owned perks show as HUD pills `"{name} x{n}"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:221`) and the offer card shows `"You have {have}. Take another?"` / `"New benefit"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Screens.cs:117`). Stats are pushed into systems by `ApplyPerks()` after every pick (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:121`, called from `OnPerkAdded` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:111`).

### 10.6 Unlocks (every unlock and its condition)

Unlock model: moves unlock when `move.unlockLevel == Level` after a promotion (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:41`), or earlier via a Training Seminar pickup (`UnlockMove`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:50`). `IsUnlocked = Level >= move.unlockLevel || trainedMoves.Contains(move.id)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:59`). Hotbar = the 10 moves of the class set in unlock-level order (`moves.OrderBy(m => m.unlockLevel)` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerClass.cs:50`, `HotbarSize = 10` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:73`); each class set = 3 asset moves + 5 `ClassMoveBook` moves + 2 shared = 10 (computed). Keys: J/K = Light/Heavy best-unlocked, I/U = best Special/Super (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:171` ⟨pre-change⟩). Locked-key presses toast `"{move} unlocks at {rank} (Lv {n})"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:247`). Non-move unlock categories (classes, perks, floors, cosmetics): none; all 4 classes, all 12 perks and the whole tower are available from the first run (grep above; no unlock flags in PlayerPrefs, see 10.7).

### 10.7 Persistence

Everything persists through Unity `PlayerPrefs` (registry on Windows; company `DefaultCompany`, product `Nine to Fight` - `ProjectSettings/ProjectSettings.asset:15`; registry path is the standard Unity one, not verified). There is no JSON/file save, no run save/resume, and no mid-run persistence: closing the game or reloading the scene discards the run entirely. A grep for `PlayerPrefs` over `Assets/_Project/Scripts` finds exactly the keys below.

### 10.8 Settings (GameSettings) - one row per setting

All stored as ints; `Max(id)` bounds: volumes 10, ScreenShake 2, others 1 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameSettings.cs:45`). Slider steps are +/-1 and clamp (no wrap): `v = max == 1 ? 1 - v : Mathf.Clamp(v + direction, 0, max);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameSettings.cs:101`). In the Options menu, left/right (NavigateX) steps by direction (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:218`), Enter/click steps +1 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:261` ⟨pre-change⟩), so mouse-only players can raise but never lower a slider (see Findings). Order in the menu = `All` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameSettings.cs:11`) followed by a "Back" row (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Screens.cs:544`). `Apply()` runs at boot (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:95`) and after each change, then raises `Changed` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameSettings.cs:122`).

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
