### 10.9 Tutorial (Floor 1 onboarding) - one row per step

Gating common to all steps (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:67`): `if (flow == null || flow.Floor != 1 || !GameSettings.Hints || flow.State == GameState.FloorCleared) { Hide(); return; }` and only advances while `flow.State == GameState.Playing` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:72`). It is a `MonoBehaviour` added at runtime (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:100`). Steps are sequential: `enum Step { Move, Attack, Dodge, Guard, Ability, Done }` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:16`); `Advance()` hides the hint, does `step++` and disables itself at `Done` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:130`). Prompt specs are rendered by `hud.ShowHint` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:128`) where `|` separates key from action and `;` separates prompts.

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Step 1 Move | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:77` | Text spec: `"A D\|Move;W S\|Change lane;Space\|Jump"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:78`; `\|` is a literal pipe) | Trigger: shown immediately when Playing starts (`if (!showing)`), records `startX`. Completion: `Mathf.Abs(player.transform.position.x - startX) > 3f && shown > 1.5f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:79`). |
| Step 2 Attack | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:81` | Text spec: `"1 J\|Attack;2 K\|Heavy attack"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:82`) | Trigger: `EnemyNear(7f)` (any active coworker within 7 units on x, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:109`). Completion: `landedHit && shown > 1.2f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:83`); `landedHit` is set by any damage sourced from the player (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:55`) and is never reset, so a hit scored during step 1 completes this step after 1.2 s. |
| Step 3 Dodge | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:85` | Text spec: `"Shift\|Dodge through their attacks"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:80` ⟨pre-change⟩) | Trigger: `wasHit` (player took damage at any time, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:39`). Completion: `shown > 4f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:81` ⟨pre-change⟩) - not on actually dodging. If the player is never hit, this step never shows and blocks steps 4-5 (see Findings). L is also bound to dodge (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:94`) but is not mentioned. |
| Step 4 Guard | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:90` | Text spec: `"2 K\|Heavy hits break an Accountant's guard"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:91`) | Trigger: a `"BLOCKED"` callout seen (`sawBlock`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:60`). Completion: `shown > 4.5f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:92`). Skip: `else if (!showing && gotKnockout && !sawBlock) Advance(); // nothing blocked yet; move on` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:93`). |
| Step 5 Ability | PARTIAL | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:95` | Text spec: `"Q\|Use your department's ability"` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:96`) | Trigger: `gotKnockout` (any KO, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:63`). Completion: `shown > 5f \|\| (player.Ability != null && player.Ability.IsActive)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:97`). `IsActive` is only true for the Rush and Shield abilities (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:30`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:96`), so for Accountant (Heal) and IT Support (StunBurst) pressing Q does not dismiss it; it just times out at 5 s. |
| Done | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:120` ⟨pre-change⟩ | `if (step >= Step.Done) enabled = false;` | After the last step the component disables itself for the rest of the scene lifetime. |
| Auto-disable when no HUD | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:29` ⟨pre-change⟩ | `if (player == null \|\| hud == null) { enabled = false; return; }` | Safety. |
| Hide outside floor 1 / when option off | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:69` | `Hide();` | Hints are re-shown if the player toggles Hints back on while still on floor 1 (state is kept). |

#### GameFeedback (what it does)

It is audio/VFX only: no score popups, no rumble. ### Comparison notes (roguelite brawlers)

Three web lookups were done; the pages were seen through search summaries, not read in full, so treat as orientation (the SoR4 sources are launch-era 2021 coverage).

- Streets of Rage 4 "Mr. X Nightmare" Survival mode: one life, fight through room/wave after room with a random buff chosen after each cleared room; buffs stack and some carry drawbacks (for example a leech effect that disables healing items); there is a Random variant and a Weekly fixed-seed gauntlet; Survival XP unlocks new moves that carry into every mode. Sources: https://primagames.com/?p=315671 , https://egmnow.com/streets-of-rage-4s-mr-x-nightmare-dlc-gets-a-release-date-and-new-trailer/ , https://www.giantbomb.com/games/3030-70072/ . Contrast with Nine to Fight: same "perk after each cleared stage, stacking, one life" skeleton, but its perks have no drawbacks/risk-reward, no seeded weekly run, and progress does not persist into move unlocks.
- Hades: boon offers have rarity tiers, can be manipulated (rerolls, keepsakes), and meta-progression (Mirror of Night) plus the Pact of Punishment "Heat" system raises difficulty after the first clear in exchange for resources. Sources: https://www.rpgsite.net/feature/10287-hades-pact-of-punishment-heat-modifiers-and-how-to-maximize-your-rewards , https://www.trueachievements.com/game/Hades/walkthrough/7 . Contrast: Nine to Fight has uniform-random, rarity-less, un-rerollable offers, no meta currency and no post-clear difficulty ladder (`BecameCeo` is cosmetic).
- Castle Crashers: each level-up grants attribute points the player allocates among four stats (Strength, Magic, Defense, Agility), with a very high level cap and extra characters unlocked via in-game tasks. Source: https://www.giantbomb.com/games/3030-20733/ . Contrast: Nine to Fight's rank ladder is an automatic linear stat-and-move grant with a 10-level cap that is hit by about floor 4, and there are no unlockable characters.

### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

**Dead / unused / partial items**

1. `TowerPlan.StartX` is dead: `public const float StartX = 0f;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:67` ⟨pre-change⟩), no reference anywhere in Scripts/Tests/Scenes/Prefabs/Data. *[changed: changelog #20]*
2. `Health.AnyDied` is dead: declared (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/Health.cs:48` ⟨pre-change⟩) and raised (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/Health.cs:80` ⟨pre-change⟩), zero subscribers. *[changed: changelog #20]*
3. `ProgressionState.Moves` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:23`) has no caller; `GameFlow.FloorLabel` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:72` ⟨pre-change⟩) has no caller; `GameHud.FadeIn()` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:103` ⟨pre-change⟩) is an empty compat stub. *[changed: changelog #20]*
4. Training Seminar pickup exists only once on Floor 1 (`Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:26621`) and always teaches Keyboard Smash; generated floors never spawn it (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:140`). Effectively a one-off.
5. `MoveLibrary.StaplerJab/BriefcaseSwing/CoffeeSplash` are only the pre-class fallback set (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:15`); in a normal run no one ever uses them.
6. No meta-progression, difficulty, scoring, seeds, rumble, save slots, or class/perk unlocks exist (see 10.6/10.7); `BestFloor`/`BecameCeo` only change one line of title-screen text (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Screens.cs:704`).

**Suspected bugs / issues (cited)**

1. **XP economy collapses the rank ladder by ~floor 4.** Cap is 1440 XP total (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/CareerLadder.cs:26` ⟨pre-change⟩) but floor-1 KO XP alone is 245 and generated floors give hundreds to thousands (`xpReward * xpScale`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:254`; F8 ~2500, F9 ~3877 by my estimate in 10.4). From ~floor 5 XP, Career Coaching (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:35`), combo XP bonus and Review Week's "XP is doubled" (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:318`) are meaningless; `if (IsMaxLevel) Xp = 0;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:45`). Needs a design pass (flatter xpReward, or levels past 10, or XP spent on something). *[changed: changelog #32]*
2. **"Promoted!" banner is overwritten.** `LeveledUp` fires the "Promoted!" banner (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:130`) and then, in the same loop iteration, `MoveUnlocked` fires "New move: ..." (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Progression/ProgressionState.cs:40`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:132`); `ShowBanner` just swaps text (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:91`). Every promotion Lv2-Lv9 grants a move, so the player only ever sees the rank banner at Lv10 (and Lv4 if Keyboard Smash was taken from the seminar). Static-trace; UNVERIFIED in play.
3. **Tutorial can stall and strand the Guard/Ability tips.** Step 3 only shows after the player has been hit (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:80` ⟨pre-change⟩), and steps 4-5 sit behind it (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:90`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:95`), so a player who is never hit on floor 1 never gets the Q ability tip. Also the Q tip does not dismiss on cast for Heal/StunBurst classes (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:97`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/AbilityCaster.cs:30`), and the tutorial replays every run (no seen flag). *[changed: changelog #25]*
4. **Fire Drill is a free floor-skip.** Elevator is open from the start and the timer is 50 s (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:322`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:429`); the elevator is at x=54.5 (`Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:24411`) so at 5-7 u/s it is roughly 8-11 s away (computed from class `moveSpeed`). Escaping wipes the floor (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:671`) for zero XP but also zero risk, skipping the whole floor's content and still granting a perk. Remaining coworkers are only `SetActive(false)`, never destroyed, and nothing in `Stage` clears them, so they accumulate under `Spawned` (minor leak, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:132` only clears pickups).
5. **Lifesteal uses pre-guard damage.** `self.Heal(info.amount * heal)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:175`) reads the local `info` before the target's `ModifyIncoming` shrinks it to 15% (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Enemies/EnemyBrain.cs:466`), so hitting a blocking Accountant heals as if the hit landed in full. Low severity.
6. **Mouse can only raise sliders.** Options row click calls `StepSetting(1)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:261` ⟨pre-change⟩) and sliders clamp rather than wrap (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameSettings.cs:101`); decreasing requires A/left.
7. **Input collisions.** Gamepad Start is both Submit and Pause (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:88` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:106`): in Paused the Submit branch wins (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:212`) so Start activates the highlighted row (can be "Quit to lobby"), and in Options Start toggles the highlighted setting instead of closing (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:220`). R / Gamepad Select restarts instantly in Paused, Ending and GameOver with no confirm (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:203` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:227` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:217` ⟨pre-change⟩) - one stray key on the perk screen discards the run. *[changed: changelog #16]*
8. **Free Coffee description mismatch.** Text says "twice as much" (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:32`) but stack 2 is x3 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:83`); Flex Time / Paid Time Off say "30% faster" but implement cooldown x0.7 per stack (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:82`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Perks.cs:87`).
9. **GameOver state quirks.** State is set directly, not via `SetState` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:644`), so camera shot/music handling differs from other transitions and Enter restarts during the 1.2 s before the letter shows (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:217` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:656`).
10. **Tower generation is spiky, not a curve.** Group size is `1 + (e + floor) / 3` with integer division (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:226`) giving 8, 10, 12, 13, 15, 17, 18, 20, 22 coworkers all alive at once, plus HP x2.6 / damage x1.8 on F9, while the player only gains power from perks (max 28 stack slots, 8 offers). Balance is UNVERIFIED (no playtest data); worth a telemetry or sim pass.
11. PlayerPrefs for `BestFloor`, `BecameCeo` and `Muted` are never `Save()`d (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:506`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:681`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/GameAudio.cs:157`); they flush on a normal quit but would be lost on a crash/kill.

**Weak designs worth rebuilding (and why)**

- Run structure: nine near-identical room re-skins in one scene with a hard-coded 5-group generator; no branching, no choice of route/reward, no mid-run rest/shop, so the only run variance is perk draws and 4 possible events. Rebuild as a data-driven floor table (ScriptableObjects) with room types and reward choices.
- Perks: no rarity, no reroll/skip, no drawbacks, single-pick-forced, flat 3-card offer, and several are linear stat bumps; a few (Career Coaching, Team Building) are dead weight given the XP cap and the 3.2 s window. Add rarity weights, rerolls and some conditional/build-defining perks (Hades/SoR4 Survival style). *[changed: changelog #32]*
- Rank ladder: auto-granted, saturates at floor ~4; either decouple rank from XP (floors/boss clears grant ranks) or add levels and a choice per level (Castle Crashers style). *[changed: changelog #32]*
- Meta: no persistence beyond two flags; adding unlockable classes/perks, an XP-to-move carry-over (SoR4) or a post-clear difficulty ladder (Hades Heat) is the biggest retention gap.
- Seeds: unseeded RNGs (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:63`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:121`) make bug repro and daily/weekly runs impossible; a single run seed would fix both.
- Tutorial: linear one-shot chain gated on events that may never occur; make it step-independent with per-tip "seen" flags (persisted) and complete-on-action.

**Open questions**

- Is the intended difficulty to hit the XP cap early (rank as a short-lived power ramp), or is the xpReward scaling (`xpScale`, Review Week x2) an oversight? *[changed: changelog #32]*
- Should floor 1's mini-boss (Middle Manager) get the same MiniBoss HP/XP/poise multipliers as generated mini-bosses? Today it does not (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:103` only sets the rank).
- Is Fire Drill meant to be a deliberate skip (risk-free) or should the elevator stay locked until some threshold?
- Registry path for PlayerPrefs, ElevatorDoor trigger size and whether mouse-only play is a target were not verified.

## 12. Audio and FX (section 12)

Scope read in full: `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/GameAudio.cs`, `Synth.cs`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Fx/ScreenFx.cs`, `HitEffects.cs`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFeedback.cs`, `Assets/_Project/Resources/FX/Dust.mat`, `Glow.mat`, `Trail.mat`. There are NO imported audio files and NO `ParticleSystem` anywhere: searched `Assets/_Project/Scripts`, `Assets/_Project/Prefabs`, `Assets/_Project/Scenes` for `ParticleSystem` (no matches) and `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime` for `AudioMixer`/`AudioClip` outside the Audio folder (no matches). All sound is synthesised at runtime and all particle-like effects are pooled primitives.

### 12.2 Synthesis primitives (apply to every sound below)

| Feature | Status | Where | Values | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sample rate / buffers | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:12` | `public const int SampleRate = 44100;` mono float clips `AudioClip.Create(name, samples.Length, 1, SampleRate, false)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:32`) | Not streamed; fully generated in memory. |
| Envelope `Env(t, attack, decay)` | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:45` | `t < attack ? t / Mathf.Max(attack, 0.0001f) : Mathf.Exp(-(t - attack) / Mathf.Max(decay, 0.0001f))` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:46`) | Linear attack then exponential decay: an "AD" envelope with no sustain and no release. Every layer is hard-cut at its `length` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:53`), so any layer whose envelope has not decayed to zero clicks at the cut (computed residuals are given per sound). *[changed: changelog #37]* |
| `Tone(buf, start, length, f0, f1, amp, attack, decay, wave)` | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:49` | frequency glides linearly `float f = Mathf.Lerp(f0, f1, t / length);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:58`); phase accumulates `phase += f / SampleRate;` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:59`); additive into the buffer (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:49` ⟨pre-change⟩) | Waveforms: `Sine` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:81`), `Square` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:82`), `Triangle` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:83`), `Saw` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:84`), `EPiano` = `Mathf.Sin(p * TwoPi) + 0.25f * Mathf.Sin(p * TwoPi * 3f)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:87`). No band-limiting: Square/Saw alias. |
| `Noise(buf, rng, start, length, amp, attack, decay, cutoff0, cutoff1)` | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:65` | white noise through a one-pole low-pass: `float a = 1f - Mathf.Exp(-TwoPi * cutoff / SampleRate);` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:75`); cutoff glides linearly (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:74`) | RNG seeded per sound `new System.Random((int)sfx * 7919 + 13)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:95`) so noise is identical every run. |
| Normalisation | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:19` ⟨pre-change⟩ | `ToClip(string name, float[] samples, bool normalize = true, float peak = 0.9f)` | Every effect is peak-normalised to 0.9, so relative loudness between sounds is decided ONLY by the volume argument at the call site (and amplitude ratios of layers inside a clip). |
| `Midi(note)` | WORKING | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:89` | `440f * Mathf.Pow(2f, (note - 69f) / 12f)` | Hz values quoted below are computed from this. |
| Silent fallback | DEAD/UNUSED | `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:200` | `b = Buffer(0.05f);` in `default:` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:199`) | Only reached for an enum value without a case; all 19 `Sfx` values have a case. |

### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

**Dead / unused / partial**
- `Sfx.Heartbeat` is synthesised on every startup but never played: enum `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/GameAudio.cs:10`, clip `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:184`; searched `Assets/_Project` `.cs/.unity/.prefab/.asset` for `Heartbeat` (only those two hits). The low-health feedback is silent apart from the visual pulse `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:383`. *[changed: changelog #26]*
- `GameHud.FadeIn()` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:103` ⟨pre-change⟩) and the 1-arg `SetEndingText(string)` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Screens.cs:55` ⟨pre-change⟩) have zero callers (searched `Assets/_Project/Scripts` and `Assets/_Project/Tests`). *[changed: changelog #20]*
- Absent features the brief asked about: no score counter, no credits screen, no standalone victory screen (the final floor reuses the Ending screen, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:682`), no held-item slot or durability, no persistent wave/objective indicator, no minimap, no localisation, no AudioMixer, no ParticleSystem, no controls rebinding. *[changed: changelog #27]*
- `GameAudio.Prewarm` skips the Lounge track (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/GameAudio.cs:140`), which is the first thing built (on the title frame).
- "Fullscreen" option is a no-op in the editor (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameSettings.cs:120`); UNVERIFIED in a build.
- The Screen shake option scales only camera shake (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Camera/SideScrollCamera.cs:119`); the lens-kick chromatic aberration, hit-stop and slow-mo are not affected by any accessibility option.

**Suspected bugs (static reading, not reproduced)**
1. Music/ambience stay ducked to 35% after "Quit to lobby" or R-while-paused: `ducked` lives on the `DontDestroyOnLoad` singleton (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/GameAudio.cs:161`), cleared only in `Resume()` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:765`), while `Restart()` just reloads the scene (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:797`).
2. Hotbar keycap stays yellow after use: `AnimateKey` only writes the colour when `down` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:315` ⟨pre-change⟩); the reset happens only in `RefreshMoves` (XP/level/class change, `void RefreshMoves()` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:265`). *[changed: changelog #19]*
3. Hard-cut envelopes cause clicks: `Env` has no release (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:46`); worst: `ElevatorHum` (residual about 0.3, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:196`), GameOver last note truncated at 0.19 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:170`), DoorSlide 0.15 to 0.19, ElevatorDing second partial 0.125. *[changed: changelog #37]*
4. Shared `AudioSource.pitch` re-pitches still-playing long one-shots when the 16-voice round-robin wraps (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/GameAudio.cs:87` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/GameAudio.cs:94`). *[changed: changelog #37]*
5. Mouse-only players cannot lower any volume: click/Enter on a slider only steps +1 and clamps (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:261` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameSettings.cs:101`).
6. Culture-dependent number text ("combo x1,1" visible in `Builds/Screenshots/04_floor_cleared.png`): `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:562` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:310`. *[changed: changelog #36]*
7. Game Over accepts Enter/R during the 1.2 s before the letter is shown: state is set immediately (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:644`), the screen is shown later (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:657`), restart input is read at `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:217` ⟨pre-change⟩.
8. The 3 s floor-cleared banner can overlap the Going-up screen because toast/banner are built above the Ending panel (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.cs:163`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.cs:165`; screenshot `Builds/Screenshots/04_floor_cleared.png`).
9. Title menu rows stay hoverable under the Options overlay (panels are `raycastTarget = false`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.cs:184`) and two highlighter rows show at once (`Builds/Screenshots/Presentation/02_options.png`); harmless but untidy.
10. `HitEffects` has a hidden dependency on the player's AbilityCaster material (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:126`); without it all scrap bursts vanish silently.
11. Gamepad Start is bound to both Submit and Pause (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:88` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:106`); while paused the Submit branch wins (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:212`) so Start activates the highlighted item rather than resuming (harmless on the default row). *[changed: changelog #16]*
12. The Pause "Controls" panel lists only Shift for dodge and omits L, R (restart) and P (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Screens.cs:578`).
13. `UiMove` (1400 Hz square beep) is reused as the in-combat blocked-hit sound despite the "dull tick" comment (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFeedback.cs:134`).

**Weak designs worth rebuilding (and why)**
- HUD and screens are one imperative ~1,700-line partial class with hundreds of hand-tuned pixel offsets, legacy `Text`, procedurally built sprites and no prefab/layout/UI Toolkit: any restyle, localisation or controller-glyph support means editing C# (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:407`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Screens.cs:448`). Z-order is an accident of build order (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.cs:158`).
- The live-portrait badge relayers the whole player to layer 30 and adds a second camera render every frame (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:340`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:354`); a bake-on-class-change snapshot would be cheaper and safer.
- Audio is 100% runtime synthesis on the main thread with no mixer, no release envelopes, no voice priority, 2D only, hard track switches and one reused clip per role (UiMove as block sound, Dodge as "WINDED"). Peak-normalising every clip (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:19` ⟨pre-change⟩) pushes all loudness balancing into call-site constants scattered over five files. *[changed: changelog #37]*
- Impact FX are per-frame CPU transforms on primitives, with an opaque ring material for debris and `TextMesh` popups with no outline: easy to lose on light floors, no batching or GPU particles, no shared data asset to tune (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Fx/HitEffects.cs:233`).
- Hotbar "Q" ability has no icon (only a colour square, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:517`); XP bar has no chip trail (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:453`); the combo XP multiplier and knockout count are never shown on the HUD.
- Tutorial/controls/prompt strings are hard-coded to keyboard keys and never swap to gamepad glyphs even though gamepad bindings exist (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/Tutorial.cs:78`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:85`).

**Open questions**
- Is the roughly 18.5 s Lounge synthesis plus `Prewarm` a visible startup hitch in a build? (not profiled)
- Does the legacy GUI text shader on the `TextMesh` popups depth-test against geometry in URP (could hide numbers behind props)? (not verified in play)
- Is Fullscreen toggling correct in a standalone build? (the editor skips it)
- Are `Builds/Screenshots/*.png` current? They match the code's UI, but `Builds/Screenshots/Presentation/01_title.png` shows "reached floor 8 of 9", i.e. a save from an earlier run, so it cannot be used to verify the new-player text.

## 13. Scene and prefabs

### 13.1 Authored or built by code?

The scene is 100% code-generated, then lightly extended at runtime. Evidence: every one of the 15 scene roots has a builder statement (`Office` `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:477`, `Coworkers` line 487, `Pickups` line 504, `Main Camera` line 511, `HUD` line 527, `Game Flow` line 528, lights in `StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:240/249/264/272`); the builder saves it with `EditorSceneManager.SaveScene` (line 535). Scene hierarchy has 453 GameObjects, 462 Transforms (9 stripped, from the 9 prefab instances), 401 MeshRenderers, 388 MeshFilters, 13 TextMeshes, 8 Lights, 11 MonoBehaviours, 4 BoxColliders, 5 SphereColliders. There is no hand-placed deviation: a root-name diff between the builder and the file is empty.

## 14. Tests (EditMode + PlayMode)

Audit of `D:\Serban\software-projects\nine-to-fight\Assets\_Project\Tests` (working tree on disk, branch nine-to-fight-overhaul). All 27 `.cs` files and both `.asmdef` files were read in full. Production classes named below were opened to confirm what each test really touches. Nothing was run; the orchestrator runs the tests.

Conventions
- Citation = `path:line` of the method declaration (`public void ...` / `public IEnumerator ...`), followed by the method signature in a second backtick span. For the one parameterised method the `[TestCase]` lines are listed in the row.
- Test IDs (E01.1, P08.1 ...) are file-number + method-order-in-file. They resolve to rows in 14.2 / 14.3 and are reused in the coverage map (14.5) so every referencing method is listed without repeating paths.
- Several files contain more than one NUnit fixture class; the class name is shown in the "kind" column when it differs from the file name.
- "Area" values: Animation, Characters/Visuals, Held items/Props, Movement/Camera, Combat, Classes/Enemies, Progression/Flow, UI, Audio/FX, Scene/Prefabs, Tooling.

### 14.5 Feature-coverage map (production classes under `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime`)

Verdict meaning: COVERED = at least one test was written to assert that class's own behaviour; INDIRECT = the class runs inside a scene/smoke test and some assertion depends on its result, but no test targets it; NONE = no assertion anywhere depends on its behaviour (it may still execute incidentally). "Gaps" lists behaviour of that class that no test asserts. Test IDs resolve to rows in 14.2 / 14.3.

### 14.7 Gameplay features with zero test coverage

Derived from the public/internal behaviour of the runtime scripts (listed class in brackets). "Zero" = no assertion in any of the 119 test methods depends on it.

Flow, menus, persistence
1. Restart (R key, pause "Back to lobby", game-over Enter) and `Restart()` scene reload [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:792`]; Quit [`:289`]. P13.1 reaches GameOver (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/PresentationTests.cs:143`) but never leaves it.
2. Pause menu -> Options -> back, Esc/Cancel handling in Paused/Options, pausing while riding the elevator [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:209`-`:214`]. Only "pause then Back to work" is exercised.
3. Class-select Cancel -> Title; left/right navigation wrap [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:187`-`:189`].
4. Save/load persistence: best floor and CEO "champion" flags in PlayerPrefs (`BestFloor`, `HasBecomeCeo`, `RecordBestFloor`) and the title "Best" line [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:504`, `:658`; `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Screens.cs:702`]. Settings reload from PlayerPrefs after domain reload is also unasserted (E09 only restores in-session).
5. Final floor (floor 9, THE CEO): no play test ever stages floor 9; so the CEO boss fight, boss music switch to `MusicTrack.Boss`, "You are the CEO" ending, `ConfirmEnding` -> restart on last floor, `slow-motion on final boss kill` [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:525`, `:565`, `:656`]. Floors 3-9 are only exercised as `TowerPlan.Build` data (E11.2, E11.3).
6. Game-over letter text and stats (knockouts, best combo, rank) [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:650`].
7. `HitStop` and `SlowMotion` time-scale routines and their pause interaction [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:803`, `:733`].
8. Floor events: PizzaParty (`coffeeDropChance` 0.55, doubled coffee) has no test at all [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:333`]; CasualFriday and ReviewWeek are never played (only plan data in E12.7/E12.8); Review Week's enemy damage x1.25 unasserted; Fire Drill timer expiry ("Drill over", elevator re-locks after 50 s) [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:484`].
9. Locked elevator: stepping into a closed elevator does nothing; `ElevatorDoor.Open/Close/IsOpen`; leftover pickups cleared per floor [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/World/ElevatorDoor.cs:35`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:132`].

### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

Likely stale / legacy-path tests
- The 20 `AttackPoseTests` (E03.*) plus `AnimationSpeedTests.NoAttackMovesTooFarInOneFrame` (`Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/AnimationSpeedTests.cs:50` ⟨pre-change⟩) measure the procedural `AttackPoses.Sample` table. When the clip set and animator are present (`EnsureClips()` true, which P01.1 asserts at `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/AttackAnimationTests.cs:38`), `CharacterVisual.LateUpdate` returns after `DriveClips` and never reaches `AttackPoses.Sample` or `FightStance.Sample` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/CharacterVisual.cs:520` ⟨pre-change⟩ `if (EnsureClips())` -> `DriveClips` at `:522` -> `return`; the procedural `fightStance.Sample`/`AttackPoses.Sample` code follows at `:525`+, sample call at `:594`). So ~24 EditMode tests guard only the fallback/legacy path; only `ImpactTime` is still live (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/FightAnimator.cs:175` ⟨pre-change⟩) and `StyleForHit` (E02.3). The shipped path is guarded by the PlayMode measurements P03.1, P01.1, P07.1, P09.*. *[changed: changelog #13, #14]*
- `BodyMechanicsTests` keeps a one-entry variant list ("clips only") alongside "shipped" (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/BodyMechanicsTests.cs:58`-`:61`); the comparison harness and the dated comment ("Compared on 2026-10-22") are residue of an experiment and the baseline is never asserted.

Tautological / weak assertions
- E02.4 `Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/AnimationSpeedTests.cs:91` ⟨pre-change⟩ `[Test] public void ImpactLandsInsideTheHitWindow`: `ImpactTime` is literally `startup + active*0.5f` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:415` ⟨pre-change⟩); can only fail on negative `active`. *[changed: changelog #13, #14]*
- E03.11 `Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/AttackPoseTests.cs:123` ⟨pre-change⟩ `[Test] public void ElbowsChamberThenSnapStraight`: NaN check is guaranteed false because `For()` resolves NaNs (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Characters/AttackPoses.cs:98` ⟨pre-change⟩-`:110`). *[changed: changelog #13, #14]*
- E03.1 `Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/AttackPoseTests.cs:19` ⟨pre-change⟩ `[Test] public void EveryStyleHasItsOwnStrike`: only fails if Strike AND Windup are both equal. *[changed: changelog #14]*
- E11.10 `Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/TowerTests.cs:121` `[Test] public void EveryEffectRendersAudibleSamples`: ">0.5 / <=1" cannot fail because `Synth.ToClip` normalises to 0.9 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Audio/Synth.cs:19` ⟨pre-change⟩-`:27`); it does catch an empty (all-zero would divide by 0.0001) or too-short buffer only. *[changed: changelog #28]*
- E13.1 `Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/WalkCycleTests.cs:9` restates `speed / stride`.
- E01.7 `Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/AbilityTests.cs:90` is one-directional (class asset with no `ClassMoveBook` entry passes).
- E01.8 `Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/AbilityTests.cs:97` forces a distinct `AbilityKind` per class; with only 4 kinds it will fail the day a 5th class is added.
- Screenshot "tests" whose only assertion is a frame count: P02.1 (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/AttackReelTests.cs:71`), P02.2 (`:130`), P02.3 (`:203`), P12.1 (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/MotionReelTests.cs:72`). P11.1 has no assertion on the camera view it claims to check (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/LevelViewTests.cs:13`-`:16`).

Flaky / timing-coupled
- P14.4 `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/VarietyPlayTests.cs:154` ⟨pre-change⟩: the StockOptions assertion only runs when the unseeded `System.Random` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:63`) happens to offer that perk (~25%); otherwise the test only checks the stack count. Same RNG drives P13.1's `SelectPerk(1)` (handled for Golden Parachute with a 3-attempt kill loop, `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/PresentationTests.cs:135`).
- Hard-coded asset values: P06.1 (35 HP, `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/ClassAbilityPlayTests.cs:63`), P06.2 (stun 2.2 s, windows 1.1 s / 2.4 s, `:83`-`:86`), P06.3 (1.5 / 1.3 / 4 s, wait 4.2 s, `:95`-`:98`), P06.4 (shield 3 s, check at 3.25 s, `:113`), P08.1 (class 1 max health 80, `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/FloorOneSmokeTests.cs:45`, ids "cable_whip"/"hard_reboot"/"mouse"), P13.1 ("Let's circle back to your beatdown", `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/PresentationTests.cs:98`), class order in the scene (index 1 = IT Support, 2 = Sales Rep, 3 = HR; `Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:22447`). Any design tuning breaks these with no logical regression. Margins of 0.2-0.25 s under frame jitter and hit-stop are thin.
- P14.3 (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/VarietyPlayTests.cs:121`): the swat must beat the projectile to the player; margin is about 0.1 s against the Accountant `ledger_slam` startup of 0.24 s (`Assets/_Project/Data/PlayerClasses/Accountant.asset:71`).
- P07.1 / P09.* use `Time.time` / `WaitForEndOfFrame` loops with thresholds 0.3 s, 0.75 m, 0.08 m, -0.06 m, 0.8 m; sensitive to editor frame rate and `Time.timeScale`. P03.1 has a per-style 5 s real-time give-up inside a 5-minute `[Timeout]` (27 styles x 2 variants).
- `TowerDirector.ForceEvent` is a static (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerDirector.cs:37`) consumed only by `Stage`; tests that set it but never call `NextFloor` (P02.*, P03.1, P07.1, P09.*, P11.1) leave `FloorEvent.None` armed for the next test, masking random events in whichever test follows.

Brittle reflection into private members
- `RigFollower.LateUpdate/Awake/carryWeight` (E06.2, E06.4), `HeldItemDisplay.LateUpdate` (E06.3), `Health.invulnerableUntil` (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/PresentationTests.cs:134`). A rename silently becomes a NullReference.

Destructive file behaviour / file output
- P12.1 deletes the whole `Builds/Screenshots/Motion` directory (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/MotionReelTests.cs:26`); P02.1-P02.3 delete all PNGs in their reel folders before each run. P01.1 and P04.1 share `Builds/Screenshots/Attacks`. Total output per full PlayMode run is well over a thousand PNGs (AttackReel alone 810 + HeldItems 204). Several screenshot paths are relative (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/DeathAnimationTests.cs:111`, `Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/FootContactTests.cs:68`) so they depend on the working directory being the project root.
- `SettingsTests` mutates real PlayerPrefs (restored in TearDown, but a crash mid-test would leave changed volume/VSync settings).

Naming / harness notes
- Fixture class names do not match file names in four files (`AbilityTests.cs` -> `CooldownTests`, `ClassAbilityContentTests`; `ProgressionTests.cs` -> `CareerLadderTests`, `ProgressionStateTests`; `TowerTests.cs` -> `TowerPlanTests`, `ComboTrackerTests`, `SynthTests`; `VarietyTests.cs` -> `PerkTests`, `FloorEventTests`). Test filters by class name must use the fixture names.
- `PlayMode` asmdef has no `includePlatforms`, unlike EditMode (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/NineToFight.Tests.PlayMode.asmdef:9`); fine for the Editor runner but the assembly would be pulled into player builds if `UNITY_INCLUDE_TESTS` is defined.
- Every PlayMode test depends on `SceneManager.LoadScene("Floor01_CubicleFarm")` and on the scene staying the first enabled entry in Build Settings (`ProjectSettings/EditorBuildSettings.asset`); Restart inside the game (R) would reload the same scene, so there is no isolation between tests beyond the scene reload (static state such as `GameAudio`'s DontDestroyOnLoad object and `PlayerController.Instance` persists).
- Test method typo: `EveryClassHasAQAbility` (`Assets/_Project/Tests/EditMode/AbilityTests.cs:49`).
- No `[Ignore]`/`[Explicit]`/Category anywhere, so there is no way to separate the ~20 screenshot/film tests (P01-P02, P05, P09-P12, parts of P06/P13/P14) from true regression tests in CI.

Open questions
1. Is the procedural `AttackPoses`/`FightStance` fallback still a supported path? If not, E03.* and E02.2 can be retired or retargeted at the clip data (`FightAnimationSet.strikes`). *[changed: changelog #13]*
2. Should the film/review tests (P02.*, P12.1, P10.1 captures) be moved behind a category or `[Explicit]` so a normal run does not spend minutes and disk on PNGs? *[changed: changelog #28]*
3. Is a seeded RNG for `GameFlow.runRng` acceptable, to make P14.4 deterministic?
4. Floors 3-9 and the CEO fight have only data-level tests; a play test that stages floor 9 and kills THE CEO would cover the whole ending branch.

### Findings (auditor notes, spot-checked by the orchestrator)

**Dead / unused / partial (cited)**
- Template leftovers: `Assets/Scenes/SampleScene.unity:135` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/Readme.asset:16` ⟨pre-change⟩, `Assets/TutorialInfo/Scripts/Editor/ReadmeEditor.cs:10` ⟨pre-change⟩ (still runs `[InitializeOnLoad]`), `Assets/InputSystem_Actions.inputactions:5` (registered as project-wide actions at `ProjectSettings/EditorBuildSettings.asset:12` but never read; the game binds keys in code, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerInputReader.cs:89`), `Assets/Settings/Mobile_RPAsset.asset:29` + `Assets/Settings/Mobile_Renderer.asset:48` (only reachable via the Mobile quality level that excludes Standalone, `ProjectSettings/QualitySettings.asset:61`). *[changed: changelog #45]*
- `Assets/_Recovery/` (5 scenes, untracked): all are Unity Test Runner "Code-based tests runner" recovery copies, not game content (`Assets/_Recovery/0.unity:133`). Safe to delete and worth git-ignoring. `Assets/InitTestScene...unity` was a transient Test Runner scene that vanished mid-audit. *[changed: changelog #1]*
- Two imported Mixamo clips are wired to nothing: `backhand.fbx` (marked `required: true` at `MIXAMO_ANIMATIONS.md:105`; `AttackStyle.Backhand` uses `horizontal_swing`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:31`) and `whip_crack.fbx` (`AttackStyle.Whip` uses `diagonal_slash`, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Animations.cs:36`). Possible regression versus the intended animation set. *[changed: changelog #21]*
- 21 unreferenced materials in `Assets/_Project/Materials/` (old procedural-character set: `Eyes`, `Shirt_Player`, `Trousers_Navy`, ...; list in 2.5.6). *[changed: changelog #29]*
- Dead code: `MixamoImport.Spins()` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/MixamoImport.cs:24` ⟨pre-change⟩), `SunsetAmber` (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Art.cs:25`). *[changed: changelog #20]*
- Unused packages: ai.navigation, timeline, visualscripting, multiplayer.center, collab-proxy, ide.rider (`Packages/manifest.json:4` (through line 14)), plus ~25 never-used built-in modules.
- Inert optional character features: `tie`, `hair`, `eyes`, `brows` are null/empty on both prefabs (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:8037` (through line 8040), `Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:5763` (through line 5766)) because the builder never wires them (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:225` ⟨pre-change⟩ (through line 228)); tie/hair dangle, blink and brow scowl in `CharacterVisual.cs:781-782, 899, 923, 943` therefore never run.
- `Builds/Windows` is stale (Runtime.dll 81 KB vs 271 KB current; Oct 21 vs Oct 23).

**Missing references / null fields**
- Scripted scan of the scene and both prefabs found 0 missing scripts (`m_Script: {fileID: 0}`), 0 unknown script GUIDs (the one non-project GUID is URP `Volume`), 0 dangling local fileIDs and 0 unresolved external GUIDs.
- Only null reference fields: `tie`/`hair` (above) and `EnemyBrain.workerClass` on the prefab (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Coworker.prefab:893`), intentionally overridden in all 8 scene instances and null-safe in code.

**Suspected bugs / risks**
- No anti-aliasing at all: `m_MSAA: 1` (`Assets/Settings/PC_RPAsset.asset:28`), `antiAliasing: 0` (`ProjectSettings/QualitySettings.asset:79`), camera has no `UniversalAdditionalCameraData` (`Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:16081` (through line 16139)). Expect shimmering on thin geometry and the skyline.
- `.mcp.json:6` hard-codes `com.gamelovers.mcp-unity@382a43a30f4d`; any package re-resolve breaks the MCP bridge path.
- `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/PlayerBuildMenu.cs:20` builds a hard-coded scene list rather than `EditorBuildSettings`; `ProjectSettings.asset:15,170` still carry `DefaultCompany` and the template bundle id `com.Unity-Technologies.com.unity.template.urp-blank`; Unity splash still on (line 20).
- Layers 28/29/30 are used as scratch render layers by editor tooling, tests, `PropIcons` and the HUD portrait but are unnamed in `TagManager.asset`; the HUD portrait puts the live player on layer 30 (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Hud.cs:338` (through line 325)) while the main camera culls nothing (`Assets/_Project/Scenes/Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity:16128`), so the portrait layer is harmless but undocumented.
- `Physics.gravity` (`ProjectSettings/DynamicsManager.asset:7`) is unused; motor gravity is `-32` (`Assets/_Project/Prefabs/Player.prefab:10246`). Layer matrix unused (all-hit `~0` mask, `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Combat/AttackExecutor.cs:194`).
- `StarterContentBuilder` deletes and recreates character mesh/avatar assets every build (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.Characters.cs:247`, line 523), so every rebuild churns ~8 tracked binary-ish assets and must be followed by regenerating both prefabs (already how `BuildAll` works, but `Rebuild Held Items` alone is safe only because it does not touch them).

**Open questions**
- Is `Builds/Screenshots` (712 MB) meant to stay on disk? It is git-ignored but large; 17 subfolders are test artefacts, `GripReview` and `MotionReview` have no generator in the repo.
- Should `PlayerClass.lightAttack/heavyAttack/signatureMove` still be authored by the builder (`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Editor/StarterContentBuilder.cs:89` (through line 148)) given the separate `ClassMoveBook.cs` move tables? Only `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerController.cs:109` reads `lightAttack.prop` outside `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Player/PlayerClass.cs:46` from what I grepped; not traced further.
- Did the scene (saved Oct 23 16:38) get regenerated after the last `StarterContentBuilder` edit (Oct 23 18:21)? Prefabs were regenerated at 18:25 and the scene only references them by GUID, so it still resolves; nothing visible differs, but I cannot execute Unity to prove the builder output equals the file byte-for-byte.

### Gameplay features with zero test coverage

Derived from the public/internal behaviour of the runtime scripts (listed class in brackets). "Zero" = no assertion in any of the 119 test methods depends on it.

Flow, menus, persistence
1. Restart (R key, pause "Back to lobby", game-over Enter) and `Restart()` scene reload [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:792`]; Quit [`:289`]. P13.1 reaches GameOver (`Assets/_Project/Tests/PlayMode/PresentationTests.cs:143`) but never leaves it.
2. Pause menu -> Options -> back, Esc/Cancel handling in Paused/Options, pausing while riding the elevator [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:209`-`:214`]. Only "pause then Back to work" is exercised.
3. Class-select Cancel -> Title; left/right navigation wrap [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:187`-`:189`].
4. Save/load persistence: best floor and CEO "champion" flags in PlayerPrefs (`BestFloor`, `HasBecomeCeo`, `RecordBestFloor`) and the title "Best" line [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:504`, `:658`; `Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/UI/GameHud.Screens.cs:702`]. Settings reload from PlayerPrefs after domain reload is also unasserted (E09 only restores in-session).
5. Final floor (floor 9, THE CEO): no play test ever stages floor 9; so the CEO boss fight, boss music switch to `MusicTrack.Boss`, "You are the CEO" ending, `ConfirmEnding` -> restart on last floor, `slow-motion on final boss kill` [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:525`, `:565`, `:656`]. Floors 3-9 are only exercised as `TowerPlan.Build` data (E11.2, E11.3).
6. Game-over letter text and stats (knockouts, best combo, rank) [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:650`].
7. `HitStop` and `SlowMotion` time-scale routines and their pause interaction [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:803`, `:733`].
8. Floor events: PizzaParty (`coffeeDropChance` 0.55, doubled coffee) has no test at all [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/TowerPlan.cs:333`]; CasualFriday and ReviewWeek are never played (only plan data in E12.7/E12.8); Review Week's enemy damage x1.25 unasserted; Fire Drill timer expiry ("Drill over", elevator re-locks after 50 s) [`Assets/_Project/Scripts/Runtime/Game/GameFlow.cs:484`].

  - Citations in this changelog point at the current tree.

  - A citation marked ⟨pre-change⟩ points at code that this changelog removed or rewrote. Read that row as a description of the audited (pre-change) state.

EditMode ran in batch mode. PlayMode ran in a windowed editor, because batch mode never fires `WaitForEndOfFrame`.

**Looked at, not changed, with reasons:**
- **Solid furniture.** Coworkers steer straight at the player with no pathfinding, so solid desks would trap them. Brawlers keep background furniture walk-through; only the floor and the end walls block.
- **Jump, fall, land, get-up and ability-cast animations.** There are no such clips in the project; they need new Mixamo downloads on your account. The jump uses a frozen run frame.
- **Blinking and scowling faces.** The Quaternius heads have their eyes as materials of the head mesh, with no eye transforms or blend shapes, so this needs new head rigs.
- **Separately authored woman grips.** This is an art pass in the Item Fitting tool. The fit tests pass on both bodies, and the extended lineup now films all six outfits with the big props (`Builds/Screenshots/Characters/lineup_*.png`) for a visual check.
- **Unused avatars inside the 30 Mixamo FBX.** Switching them to copy one avatar means reimporting every clip and re-measuring every strike, which risks the retargeting for no runtime gain.
- **`InputSystem_Actions.inputactions`.** It's registered as the project-wide actions asset; the game reads input in code. Harmless, so it stays.
- **`Builds/Screenshots` (712 MB, git-ignored) and `Assets/_Recovery`.** Waiting for your decision.

**Not done, by design** (owner's decision, unchanged): player prop pickup and throwing, item durability, a player block or parry, a difficulty setting, credits and score screens.

**Housekeeping after the test runs:** the test runner's leftover `Assets/InitTestScene*.unity` files were deleted each time.
- `Floor01_CubicleFarm.unity` is byte-identical to the audited version.
- `Player.prefab` and `Coworker.prefab` differ only by the renderer-list lines of #43: 3 lines each.
- Data assets changed:
  - `FightAnimations.asset`: the SupermanPunch strike removed (#22), and grounding re-measured after the loop fix (#42).
  - `ITSupport.asset`: #17.
- `Art/Animations/Generated/Idle.anim`, `Walk.anim` and `Run.anim` were regenerated (#42).
- Nothing was committed by these runs.
